ts
import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import type { Ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp, h } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from '../templates/administration/examples/App.vue';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	options?: { fullWidth?: Ref<boolean> }
) {
	const apps: ReturnType<typeof createOwnerApp>[] = [];
	const createApp: typeof createOwnerApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		if (options?.fullWidth)
			app.provide(Symbol.for('asam.website.preview.fullWidth'), options.fullWidth);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};

	async function mountAdministration(initialFamily?: 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'technology') {
		if (initialFamily && location.pathname.endsWith('.html'))
			history.replaceState(null, '', `/?family=${initialFamily}`);
		const router = createRouter({
			history: createWebHistory(),
			routes: [
				{ path: '/', component: { render: () => h('div') } },
				{ path: '/safe', component: { render: () => h('div') } }
			]
		});
		const application = createApp(App, { initialFamily }).use(router);
		await router.isReady();
		return application.mount(element);
	}

	await mountAdministration();
	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { SecurityStatus } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { useAdministrationI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useAdministrationI18n();
import { nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, provide, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { RouterView, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createSecurityNavigation } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { administrationKey } from './Types.js';
import type { AdministrationHost } from './Types.js';
import UsersPage from './UsersPage.vue';
import RolesPage from './RolesPage.vue';
import MenusPage from './MenusPage.vue';
import './styles.css';
const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<{
		host: AdministrationHost;
		family?: 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'technology';
		mode?: 'light' | 'dark';
	}>(),
	{ family: 'minimal', mode: 'light' }
);
const securityStatus = (value: SecurityStatus) => {
	const keys = {
		anonymous: 'app.templates.administration.securityanonymous',
		restoring: 'app.templates.administration.securityrestoring',
		authenticating: 'app.templates.administration.securityauthenticating',
		refreshing: 'app.templates.administration.securityrefreshing',
		switching: 'app.templates.administration.securityswitching',
		authenticated: 'app.templates.administration.securityauthenticated',
		expired: 'app.templates.administration.securityexpired',
		error: 'app.templates.administration.securityerror',
		'logging-out': 'app.templates.administration.securitylogging-out',
		disposed: 'app.templates.administration.securitydisposed'
	} as const;
	return i18n.enabled.value ? i18n.t(keys[value]) : value;
};
const router = useRouter(),
	content = ref<HTMLElement>(),
	leaves = new Set<() => Promise<boolean>>();
const serviceGeneration = ref(0);
function currentAttributes(path: string | undefined): Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'aria-current'> {
	return { 'aria-current': router.currentRoute.value.path === path ? 'page' : undefined };
}
provide(administrationKey, { ...props.host, leaves });
// Router START_LOCATION is '/' even when a normal host is beginning a deep-link navigation.
const initialLocation = router.options.history.location || router.currentRoute.value.fullPath;
const bridge = createSecurityNavigation({
	i18n,
	security: props.host.security,
	router,
	components: { users: UsersPage, roles: RolesPage, menus: MenusPage },
	items: [
		{ id: 'users', title: '用户管理', path: '/users', resource: 'users', cache: false },
		{ id: 'roles', title: '角色管理', path: '/roles', resource: 'roles', cache: false },
		{ id: 'menus', title: '菜单权限', path: '/menus', resource: 'menus', cache: false }
	],
	rules: {
		'/users': { permission: 'users:read' },
		'/roles': { permission: 'roles:read' },
		'/menus': { permission: 'menus:read' }
	},
	publicPaths: ['/', '/safe'],
	safePage: '/safe'
});
const navigation = bridge.navigation;
bridge.resume(router.resolve(initialLocation).path === '/' ? '/users' : initialLocation);
const guard = router.beforeEach(async (to, from) => {
	if (
		to.path === from.path ||
		to.path === '/safe' ||
		props.host.security.state.value.status !== 'authenticated'
	)
		return true;
	const epoch = props.host.security.state.value.epoch;
	for (const leave of leaves)
		if (!(await leave()) || epoch !== props.host.security.state.value.epoch) return false;
	return true;
});
const after = router.afterEach(async () => {
	await nextTick();
	content.value?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
});
const unsubscribe = props.host.security.onInvalidate(() => {
	void nextTick(() => content.value?.focus());
});
const stop = watch(
	() => props.host.services.value,
	() => {
		serviceGeneration.value++;
		leaves.clear();
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	guard();
	after();
	unsubscribe();
	stop();
	bridge.dispose();
});
defineExpose({ navigation, resume: bridge.resume });
</script>

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { AsamCrudCodec } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition, AsamFieldModel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { UserEdit, RoleEdit, MenuEdit, Id } from './Types.js';
import { fields, stringField as text, versionValue, denseArray } from './Validation.js';
import { isId } from './Tree.js';
const ids = (v: unknown): Id[] => {
	denseArray(v);
	if (!v.every(isId) || new Set(v).size !== v.length)
		throw createAsamMessageError('角色集合无效', 'app.templates.administration.copy85c4a99b0a');
	return [...v];
};
const version = (m: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) => versionValue(m.version);
const userKeys = ['name', 'account', 'status', 'roleIds', 'context', 'note', 'version'];
const roleKeys = ['name', 'code', 'enabled', 'members', 'note', 'context', 'version'];
const menuKeys = ['parentId', 'title', 'kind', 'permissionCode', 'enabled', 'grantable', 'version'];
export const versionField: AsamFieldDefinition = {
	key: 'version',
	label: '版本',
	kind: 'text',
	modes: { edit: { hidden: true } },
	submitHidden: true,
	submit: (value) => {
		if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(value))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'版本输入无效',
				'app.templates.administration.copyc6338a0e11'
			);
		return versionValue(Number(value));
	}
};
export const userCodec: AsamCrudCodec<UserEdit> = {
	encode: (m) => {
		fields(m, userKeys);
		const valid = userCodec.decode(m);
		return { ...valid, roleIds: [...valid.roleIds], version: String(valid.version) };
	},
	decode: (m) => {
		fields(m, userKeys);
		return {
			name: text(m, 'name'),
			account: text(m, 'account'),
			status: text(m, 'status'),
			roleIds: ids(m.roleIds),
			context: text(m, 'context'),
			note: text(m, 'note'),
			version: version(m)
		};
	}
};
export const roleCodec: AsamCrudCodec<RoleEdit> = {
	encode: (m) => {
		fields(m, roleKeys);
		const valid = roleCodec.decode(m);
		return { ...valid, version: String(valid.version) };
	},
	decode: (m) => {
		fields(m, roleKeys);
		return {
			name: text(m, 'name'),
			code: text(m, 'code'),
			enabled: text(m, 'enabled'),
			members: text(m, 'members'),
			note: text(m, 'note'),
			context: text(m, 'context'),
			version: version(m)
		};
	}
};
export const menuCodec: AsamCrudCodec<MenuEdit> = {
	encode: (m) => {
		fields(m, menuKeys);
		const valid = menuCodec.decode(m);
		return { ...valid, version: String(valid.version) };
	},
	decode: (m) => {
		fields(m, menuKeys);
		const p = m.parentId;
		if (p !== null && !isId(p))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'父节点无效',
				'app.templates.administration.copyfe94f6e478'
			);
		return {
			parentId: p,
			title: text(m, 'title'),
			kind: text(m, 'kind'),
			permissionCode: text(m, 'permissionCode'),
			enabled: text(m, 'enabled'),
			grantable: text(m, 'grantable'),
			version: version(m)
		};
	}
};
/** Explicit alternate host DTOs; IDs retain their original number/string type. */
export interface DirectoryUserDTO {
	uid: Id;
	display: string;
	login: string;
	active: boolean;
	associations: Id[];
	area: string;
	memo: string;
	revision: number;
}
export interface CatalogUserDTO {
	key: Id;
	profile: { title: string; handle: string };
	state: 'open' | 'closed';
	groups: Id[];
	zone: string;
	annotation: string;
	etag: number;
}
export const directoryUser = {
	from: (d: DirectoryUserDTO) => {
		fields(d, [
			'uid',
			'display',
			'login',
			'active',
			'associations',
			'area',
			'memo',
			'revision'
		]);
		if (!isId(d.uid) || typeof d.active !== 'boolean')
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'目录用户字段无效',
				'app.templates.administration.copy96df8e8c42'
			);
		return {
			id: d.uid,
			name: text(d, 'display'),
			account: text(d, 'login'),
			status: d.active ? '启用' : '停用',
			roleIds: ids(d.associations),
			context: text(d, 'area'),
			note: text(d, 'memo'),
			version: versionValue(d.revision)
		};
	},
	to: (m: Readonly<UserEdit>): Omit<DirectoryUserDTO, 'uid'> => {
		fields(m, userKeys);
		userCodec.decode(m);
		if (!['启用', '停用'].includes(m.status))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'目录状态映射无效',
				'app.templates.administration.copy7e73fcd42f'
			);
		return {
			display: m.name,
			login: m.account,
			active: m.status === '启用',
			associations: [...m.roleIds],
			area: m.context,
			memo: m.note,
			revision: m.version
		};
	}
};
export const catalogUser = {
	from: (d: CatalogUserDTO) => {
		fields(d, ['key', 'profile', 'state', 'groups', 'zone', 'annotation', 'etag']);
		fields(d.profile, ['title', 'handle']);
		if (!isId(d.key) || !['open', 'closed'].includes(d.state))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'目录用户字段无效',
				'app.templates.administration.copy96df8e8c42'
			);
		return {
			id: d.key,
			name: text(d.profile, 'title'),
			account: text(d.profile, 'handle'),
			status: d.state === 'open' ? '启用' : '停用',
			roleIds: ids(d.groups),
			context: text(d, 'zone'),
			note: text(d, 'annotation'),
			version: versionValue(d.etag)
		};
	},
	to: (m: Readonly<UserEdit>): Omit<CatalogUserDTO, 'key'> => {
		fields(m, userKeys);
		userCodec.decode(m);
		if (!['启用', '停用'].includes(m.status))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'目录状态映射无效',
				'app.templates.administration.copy7e73fcd42f'
			);
		return {
			profile: { title: m.name, handle: m.account },
			state: m.status === '启用' ? 'open' : 'closed',
			groups: [...m.roleIds],
			zone: m.context,
			annotation: m.note,
			etag: m.version
		};
	}
};
export function decodeUserPayload(model: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>) {
	return userCodec.decode(model);
}
ts
import { useAdministrationI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { administrationMessage } from './i18n/Message.js';
import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import { inject, onBeforeUnmount, watch } from 'vue';
import { defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamCrudController } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamCrudCodec, AsamCrudServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition, AsamOperationColumn } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createTemplateId } from '../shared/Id.js';
import { administrationKey } from './Types.js';
import type { AdministrationHost, Entity, Id, Query, Request } from './Types.js';
import { isId } from './Tree.js';
import { fields, stringField, versionValue } from './Validation.js';

export const initialQuery: Query = { keyword: '', status: '', role: null, context: '' };
export function useAdministration() {
	const host = inject(administrationKey);
	if (!host)
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			'需要 AdministrationHost',
			'app.templates.administration.copy8f6e3faf2f'
		);
	return host;
}
export const text = stringField;
export const version = (model: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) => versionValue(model.version);
export const queryCodec: AsamCrudCodec<Query> = {
	encode: (q) => ({ ...queryCodec.decode(q) }),
	decode: (q) => {
		fields(q, ['keyword', 'status', 'role', 'context']);
		const m = q;
		if (m.role !== null && !isId(m.role))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'角色条件无效',
				'app.templates.administration.copy8ecdb81de1'
			);
		return {
			keyword: text(m, 'keyword'),
			status: text(m, 'status'),
			context: text(m, 'context'),
			role: m.role
		};
	}
};
/** 003 explicitly omits empty query values. Only this named projection boundary restores them. */
export const queryProjectionCodec: AsamCrudCodec<Query> = {
	encode: queryCodec.encode,
	decode: (q) => {
		fields(q, [], ['keyword', 'status', 'role', 'context']);
		return queryCodec.decode({ ...initialQuery, ...q });
	}
};
export const queryFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{ key: 'keyword', kind: 'text', label: '关键字' },
	{ key: 'status', kind: 'text', label: '状态' },
	{
		key: 'role',
		kind: 'single',
		label: '角色',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({ options: [] })
	},
	{ key: 'context', kind: 'text', label: '上下文' }
];
export const field = (
	key: string,
	label: string,
	requiredMessage?: () => string
): AsamFieldDefinition => ({
	key,
	label,
	kind: 'text',
	...(['name', 'account', 'code', 'title'].includes(key)
		? {
				modes: {
					edit: {
						rules: [{ required: true, message: requiredMessage ?? `请输入${label}` }]
					}
				}
			}
		: {})
});
export async function readHostOptions<T>(
	host: AdministrationHost,
	entity: Entity,
	request: (context: Request) => Promise<T>
): Promise<T> {
	const service = host.services.value,
		epoch = host.security.state.value.epoch,
		c = host.runtime.createContext();
	const current = () =>
		service === host.services.value &&
		epoch === host.security.state.value.epoch &&
		host.runtime.isCurrent(c) &&
		host.security.check({ permission: `${entity}:read` }) === 'allowed';
	try {
		if (!current()) throw new Error();
		const result = await request({ ...c, isCurrent: current });
		if (!current()) throw new Error();
		return result;
	} catch {
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			'候选读取失败，请重试',
			'app.templates.administration.copy7a71b42fbe'
		);
	} finally {
		host.runtime.release(c);
	}
}
export function useAdministrationCrud<Row extends { id: Id }, Edit extends object>(
	host: AdministrationHost,
	entity: Entity,
	services: AsamCrudServices<Row, Query, Edit, Id>,
	codec: AsamCrudCodec<Edit>,
	fields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[],
	columns: readonly AsamOperationColumn<Row>[],
	queries: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = queryFields
) {
	const i18n = useAdministrationI18n();
	const bound = host.services.value;
	const serviceVersion = bound.version;
	const epoch = host.security.state.value.epoch;
	const currentScope = () =>
		host.security.state.value.subject ? scopeKey(host.security.state.value.subject) : '';
	const scope = currentScope();
	const current = () =>
		host.services.value === bound &&
		bound.version === serviceVersion &&
		host.security.state.value.epoch === epoch &&
		currentScope() === scope;
	const read = () =>
		current() && host.security.check({ permission: `${entity}:read` }) === 'allowed';
	const write = () =>
		read() && host.security.check({ permission: `${entity}:write`, write: true }) === 'allowed';
	const safeRead = async <T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
		if (!read())
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'当前读取已关闭',
				'app.templates.administration.copyb8d5d41d6e'
			);
		try {
			const value = await fn();
			if (!read()) throw new Error();
			return value;
		} catch {
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'资料读取失败，请重试',
				'app.templates.administration.copy31485a382c'
			);
		}
	};
	// The 024 controller freezes operations, checks permissions around confirmation,
	// retains unknown writes and owns list/editor/detail orchestration.
	const guarded: AsamCrudServices<Row, Query, Edit, Id> = {
		list: (q, c) => safeRead(() => services.list(q, c)),
		defaults: (c) => safeRead(() => services.defaults(c)),
		load: (k, c) => safeRead(() => services.load(k, c)),
		create: (m, o, c) =>
			write()
				? services
						.create(m, o, c)
						.catch(() =>
							administrationMessage(
								{ status: 'unknown' },
								'写入结果未知，请核实',
								'app.templates.administration.copy449f6a68bc'
							)
						)
				: Promise.resolve(
						administrationMessage(
							{ status: 'failure' },
							'权限已撤销，未发送',
							'app.templates.administration.copyf1e8a7012d'
						)
					),
		update: (k, m, o, c) =>
			write()
				? services
						.update(k, m, o, c)
						.catch(() =>
							administrationMessage(
								{ status: 'unknown' },
								'写入结果未知，请核实',
								'app.templates.administration.copy449f6a68bc'
							)
						)
				: Promise.resolve(
						administrationMessage(
							{ status: 'failure' },
							'权限已撤销，未发送',
							'app.templates.administration.copyf1e8a7012d'
						)
					),
		verify: (o, c) => safeRead(() => services.verify(o, c)),
		resolve: (k, c) => safeRead(() => services.resolve(k, c)),
		remove: (t, s) =>
			write()
				? services
						.remove(t, s)
						.catch(() =>
							administrationMessage(
								{ key: t.key, status: 'unknown' },
								'删除结果未知',
								'app.templates.administration.copyac861d9241'
							)
						)
				: Promise.resolve(
						administrationMessage(
							{ key: t.key, status: 'failure' },
							'权限已撤销，未发送',
							'app.templates.administration.copyf1e8a7012d'
						)
					),
		verifyRemove: (t, s) => safeRead(() => services.verifyRemove(t, s))
	};
	const crud = useAsamCrudController<Row, Query, Edit, Id>({
		runtime: host.runtime,
		writes: host.writes,
		operations: host.operations,
		rowKey: (r) => r.id,
		isKey: isId,
		dataset: () => JSON.stringify([scope, bound.version, entity]),
		initial: { ...initialQuery },
		queryFields: queries,
		queryCodec: queryProjectionCodec,
		editFields: fields,
		detailFields: fields,
		editCodec: codec,
		services: guarded,
		detail: {
			mode: 'load',
			load: async (id, context) => ({
				status: 'ready',
				data: codec.encode(await guarded.load(id, context))
			})
		},
		columns,
		preferences: {
			scope: () => ({
				application: 'administration',
				principal: scope,
				table: entity,
				version: bound.version
			}),
			adapter: { load: async () => null, save: async () => {}, reset: async () => {} }
		},
		pageSize: 20,
		disabled: () => !read(),
		readonly: () => !write(),
		allowed: (a) => (a === 'detail' ? read() : write()),
		allowedRemove: () => write(),
		confirmDiscard: () => host.confirm(i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy66cf705688')),
		confirmRemove: (s) =>
			host.confirm(
				i18n.t('app.templates.administration.confirmRemove', {
					count: s.targets.length,
					keys: s.targets.map((t) => `${typeof t.key}:${t.key}`).join('、')
				})
			),
		operationId: () => createTemplateId()
	});
	const clear = () => {
		crud.editor.invalidate();
		crud.detail.close();
		crud.selection.clear();
	};
	const unsubscribe = host.security.onInvalidate(clear);
	const stop = watch(() => host.services.value, clear, { flush: 'sync' });
	const leave = async () =>
		!crud.editor.dirty.value ||
		host.confirm(i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copyb733baa474'));
	host.leaves?.add(leave);
	onBeforeUnmount(() => {
		host.leaves?.delete(leave);
		unsubscribe();
		stop();
		crud.dispose();
	});
	return crud;
}
ts
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { formatFieldIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { createAsamMessageError, createAsamMessageIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import { createTemplateId } from '../shared/Id.js';
import { computed, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { isId, validateTree } from './Tree.js';
import { fields, denseArray } from './Validation.js';
import type {
	AdministrationHost,
	GrantOperation,
	GrantSnapshot,
	Id,
	GrantResult
} from './Types.js';

function grantResult(value: unknown): GrantResult {
	fields(value, ['status'], ['version', 'reason']);
	if (value.status === 'success') {
		fields(value, ['status', 'version']);
		if (typeof value.version !== 'string' || !value.version.trim())
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'授权回执版本无效',
				'app.templates.administration.copyf3a0863537'
			);
		return { status: 'success', version: value.version };
	}
	if (value.status === 'unknown') {
		fields(value, ['status']);
		return { status: 'unknown' };
	}
	if (value.status === 'failure') {
		fields(value, ['status', 'reason']);
		if (
			value.reason === 'conflict' ||
			value.reason === 'validation' ||
			value.reason === 'denied'
		)
			return { status: 'failure', reason: value.reason };
	}
	throw createAsamMessageError('授权回执无效', 'app.templates.administration.copy0cad7114a2');
}

/** Owns only local reads/drafts. Writes and receipts belong to the host. */
export function createGrantEditor(host: AdministrationHost, i18n?: AsamI18n) {
	const snapshot = shallowRef<GrantSnapshot | null>(null);
	const selected = ref<Id[]>([]),
		filter = ref(''),
		message = ref('');
	const messageOrigin = shallowRef<{ readonly message: string }>();
	function setMessage(issue: string | { readonly message: string }) {
		message.value = typeof issue === 'string' ? issue : issue.message;
		messageOrigin.value = typeof issue === 'string' ? undefined : issue;
	}
	const status = ref<
		'closed' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error' | 'saving' | 'unknown' | 'verifying'
	>('closed');
	let generation = 0,
		alive = true,
		abort: AbortController | undefined;
	let active: Id | undefined,
		revision = 0,
		action = 0;
	let pending: GrantOperation | undefined;
	let pendingDraftRevision: number | undefined;
	let pendingOwned = false;
	const scope = () =>
		host.security.state.value.subject ? scopeKey(host.security.state.value.subject) : '';
	const canRead = () => alive && host.security.check({ permission: 'roles:read' }) === 'allowed';
	const writable = computed(
		() =>
			canRead() &&
			host.security.check({ permission: 'roles:write', write: true }) === 'allowed'
	);
	const dirty = computed(
		() =>
			!!snapshot.value &&
			(selected.value.length !== snapshot.value.direct.length ||
				selected.value.some((id) => !snapshot.value!.direct.includes(id)))
	);
	const tree = computed(() => (snapshot.value ? validateTree(snapshot.value.nodes) : []));
	const visible = computed(
		() =>
			snapshot.value?.nodes.filter((n) =>
				n.title.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(filter.value.toLocaleLowerCase())
			) ?? []
	);
	function clear() {
		// Increment and erase before abort: synchronous abort listeners may reenter.
		const stamp = ++generation;
		action++;
		revision++;
		const previous = abort;
		abort = undefined;
		if (
			pendingOwned &&
			pending &&
			host.receipts.get(pending.operationId)?.status === 'confirming'
		)
			host.receipts.delete(pending.operationId);
		active = undefined;
		pending = undefined;
		pendingDraftRevision = undefined;
		pendingOwned = false;
		snapshot.value = null;
		selected.value = [];
		filter.value = '';
		setMessage('');
		status.value = 'closed';
		previous?.abort();
		return stamp;
	}
	const unsubscribe = host.security.onInvalidate(clear);
	const stop = watch(() => [host.services.value, host.services.value.version], clear, {
		flush: 'sync'
	});
	async function discard(): Promise<boolean> {
		const token = generation;
		return (
			!dirty.value ||
			((await host.confirm(
				i18n?.enabled.value
					? i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copye5c8f3a96a')
					: '授权草稿尚未保存，确认丢弃？'
			)) &&
				token === generation)
		);
	}
	async function open(subject: Id, force = false) {
		if (!isId(subject) || !canRead()) return false;
		if (!force && !(await discard())) return false;
		if (!canRead()) return false;
		const token = clear();
		if (token !== generation || !canRead()) return false;
		const epoch = host.security.state.value.epoch,
			service = host.services.value;
		active = subject;
		const controller = new AbortController();
		abort = controller;
		const current = () =>
			alive &&
			token === generation &&
			epoch === host.security.state.value.epoch &&
			service === host.services.value &&
			canRead();
		status.value = 'loading';
		try {
			const data = await service.grants.load(subject, {
				signal: controller.signal,
				isCurrent: current,
				scope: scope()
			});
			if (!current()) return false;
			fields(data, ['subject', 'scope', 'version', 'nodes', 'direct', 'unavailable']);
			denseArray(data.direct);
			if (
				!Object.is(data.subject, subject) ||
				data.scope !== scope() ||
				typeof data.version !== 'string' ||
				!data.version.trim() ||
				!['preserve', 'reject'].includes(data.unavailable)
			)
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'授权响应对象不匹配',
					'app.templates.administration.copy3206ff65fd'
				);
			validateTree(data.nodes);
			if (
				data.direct.some((id) => !isId(id)) ||
				new Set(data.direct).size !== data.direct.length
			)
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'授权集合无效',
					'app.templates.administration.copye43ab165a3'
				);
			const unavailable = data.direct.filter(
				(id) => !data.nodes.some((n) => Object.is(n.id, id) && n.enabled && n.grantable)
			);
			if (unavailable.length && data.unavailable === 'reject')
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'服务策略拒绝当前不可授予权限',
					'app.templates.administration.copyfbaafef20e'
				);
			snapshot.value = {
				...data,
				nodes: data.nodes.map((n) => ({ ...n })),
				direct: [...data.direct]
			};
			selected.value = [...data.direct];
			status.value = 'ready';
			// A remount cannot issue a new write to an unresolved subject.
			const retained = [...host.receipts.values()].find(
				(r) =>
					r.operation.scope === data.scope &&
					Object.is(r.operation.subject, subject) &&
					['confirming', 'sending', 'unknown'].includes(r.status)
			);
			if (retained) {
				pending = retained.operation;
				pendingDraftRevision = revision;
				pendingOwned = false;
				status.value = 'unknown';
				setMessage(
					createAsamMessageIssue(
						'原操作未决，请核实同一操作',
						'app.templates.administration.copy1d62f14a53'
					)
				);
			}
			return true;
		} catch {
			if (current()) {
				snapshot.value = null;
				selected.value = [];
				status.value = 'error';
				setMessage(
					createAsamMessageIssue(
						'授权读取失败或树结构无效，请重试；未显示部分结果',
						'app.templates.administration.copyf244747f1a'
					)
				);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	function toggle(id: Id, checked: boolean) {
		if (!writable.value || !snapshot.value || !['ready', 'saving'].includes(status.value))
			return;
		const node = snapshot.value.nodes.find((n) => Object.is(n.id, id));
		if (!node?.enabled || !node.grantable) return;
		const next = new Set(selected.value);
		if (checked) next.add(id);
		else next.delete(id);
		selected.value = [...next];
		revision++;
	}
	function selectVisible(checked: boolean, ids: readonly Id[] = visible.value.map((n) => n.id)) {
		for (const id of ids) toggle(id, checked);
	}
	async function save() {
		if (
			!writable.value ||
			!snapshot.value ||
			status.value !== 'ready' ||
			!dirty.value ||
			pending
		)
			return;
		const conflict = [...host.receipts.values()].find(
			(r) =>
				r.operation.scope === snapshot.value!.scope &&
				Object.is(r.operation.subject, snapshot.value!.subject) &&
				['confirming', 'sending', 'unknown'].includes(r.status)
		);
		if (conflict) {
			pending = conflict.operation;
			pendingDraftRevision = undefined;
			pendingOwned = false;
			status.value = 'unknown';
			setMessage(
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					'宿主已有当前对象未决写入，请核实原操作',
					'app.templates.administration.copyd5e4ef8300'
				)
			);
			return;
		}
		const token = generation,
			epoch = host.security.state.value.epoch,
			draftRevision = revision,
			service = host.services.value;
		const data = snapshot.value;
		const operation: GrantOperation = Object.freeze({
			operationId: createTemplateId(),
			subject: data.subject,
			scope: data.scope,
			serviceVersion: service.version,
			version: data.version,
			direct: Object.freeze([...selected.value])
		});
		// Reserve synchronously, before awaiting confirmation (double-click safe).
		status.value = 'saving';
		pending = operation;
		pendingDraftRevision = draftRevision;
		pendingOwned = true;
		host.receipts.set(operation.operationId, { operation, status: 'confirming' });
		const attempt = ++action;
		const current = () =>
			alive &&
			token === generation &&
			epoch === host.security.state.value.epoch &&
			service === host.services.value &&
			attempt === action &&
			canRead();
		let confirmed = false;
		try {
			confirmed = await host.confirm(
				i18n?.enabled.value
					? i18n.t('app.templates.administration.confirmSave', {
							count: operation.direct.length
						})
					: `保存当前角色的 ${operation.direct.length} 项直接授权？`
			);
		} catch {
			/* fixed safe feedback below */
		}
		if (!current()) return;
		if (!confirmed || !writable.value) {
			host.receipts.delete(operation.operationId);
			pending = undefined;
			status.value = 'ready';
			setMessage(
				confirmed
					? createAsamMessageIssue(
							'写入权限已撤销',
							'app.templates.administration.copy80ff2c386e'
						)
					: createAsamMessageIssue(
							'已取消保存',
							'app.templates.administration.copy6804d4004a'
						)
			);
			return;
		}
		const record = { operation, status: 'sending' as const };
		host.receipts.set(operation.operationId, record);
		let result: GrantResult;
		try {
			if (!current() || !writable.value) {
				host.receipts.delete(operation.operationId);
				pending = undefined;
				status.value = 'ready';
				return;
			}
			result = grantResult(
				await service.grants.save(operation, {
					signal: new AbortController().signal,
					isCurrent: current,
					scope: operation.scope
				})
			);
		} catch {
			result = { status: 'unknown' };
		}
		host.receipts.set(operation.operationId, { operation, status: result.status, result });
		if (!current()) return;
		apply(result, operation, draftRevision);
	}
	function apply(
		result: GrantResult,
		operation: GrantOperation,
		draftRevision: number | undefined
	) {
		const ownedResult = pendingOwned;
		if (result.status === 'unknown') {
			status.value = 'unknown';
			setMessage(
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					'结果未知，禁止重发；请核实原 operationId',
					'app.templates.administration.copy73ab6549e4'
				)
			);
			return;
		}
		pending = undefined;
		status.value = 'ready';
		if (result.status === 'failure') {
			setMessage(
				result.reason === 'conflict'
					? createAsamMessageIssue(
							'版本冲突，服务确认未应用；请明确重新加载并合并',
							'app.templates.administration.copya9c9f7afe2'
						)
					: createAsamMessageIssue(
							'服务拒绝或校验失败，确认未应用；草稿保留',
							'app.templates.administration.copyde0231899c'
						)
			);
			return;
		}
		if (snapshot.value)
			snapshot.value = {
				...snapshot.value,
				version: result.version,
				direct: [...operation.direct]
			};
		if (draftRevision !== undefined && revision === draftRevision)
			selected.value = [...operation.direct];
		pendingDraftRevision = undefined;
		pendingOwned = false;
		setMessage(
			ownedResult
				? createAsamMessageIssue(
						'授权已保存；保存期间的后续修改保留',
						'app.templates.administration.copya4ce5d0df5'
					)
				: createAsamMessageIssue(
						'原操作已核实，已更新授权基线；本地草稿保留，请核对后保存',
						'app.templates.administration.copyea81390f04'
					)
		);
	}
	async function verify() {
		if (!canRead() || !pending || status.value !== 'unknown') return;
		const operation = pending,
			token = generation,
			service = host.services.value,
			draftRevision = pendingDraftRevision;
		const retained = host.receipts.get(operation.operationId);
		if (retained?.status === 'sending' || retained?.status === 'confirming') {
			setMessage(
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					'原操作仍在确认或发送，请等待',
					'app.templates.administration.copyc6730bb27a'
				)
			);
			return;
		}
		if (!retained) {
			pending = undefined;
			status.value = 'ready';
			setMessage(
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					'原操作已取消且未发送，可继续编辑',
					'app.templates.administration.copy3703596b6f'
				)
			);
			return;
		}
		if (operation.serviceVersion !== service.version || operation.scope !== scope()) return;
		status.value = 'verifying';
		const current = () =>
			alive && token === generation && canRead() && service === host.services.value;
		let result: GrantResult;
		try {
			result = grantResult(
				await service.grants.verify(operation, {
					signal: new AbortController().signal,
					isCurrent: current,
					scope: operation.scope
				})
			);
		} catch {
			result = { status: 'unknown' };
		}
		host.receipts.set(operation.operationId, { operation, status: result.status, result });
		if (current()) apply(result, operation, draftRevision);
	}
	async function close() {
		if (!(await discard())) return false;
		clear();
		return true;
	}
	return {
		snapshot,
		selected,
		filter,
		message: computed({
			get: () => message.value,
			set: (value: string) => {
				message.value = value;
				messageOrigin.value = undefined;
			}
		}),
		formatMessage: (scope: AsamI18n) =>
			messageOrigin.value ? formatFieldIssue(messageOrigin.value, scope) : message.value,
		status,
		dirty,
		tree,
		visible,
		writable,
		open,
		toggle,
		selectVisible,
		save,
		verify,
		close,
		reload: () => (active === undefined ? Promise.resolve(false) : open(active)),
		invalidate: clear,
		dispose: () => {
			alive = false;
			clear();
			unsubscribe();
			stop();
		}
	};
}
vue
<template>
	<section
		v-if="editor.status.value !== 'closed'"
		class="grant-editor"
		:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy8a4e8db8ed')"
		:aria-busy="editor.status.value === 'loading'"
	>
		<h3 ref="heading" tabindex="-1">

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAdministrationI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useAdministrationI18n();
import { nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInput, AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize, AsamTreeExpose, AsamTreeNodeData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createGrantEditor } from './GrantController.js';
import { useAdministration } from './Crud.js';
import { keyOf } from './Tree.js';
import type { TreeNode } from './Tree.js';
import type { Id } from './Types.js';
defineProps<{ size?: AsamControlSize }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ closed: [] }>();
const host = useAdministration();
const editor = createGrantEditor(host, i18n);
const leave = async () =>
	!editor.dirty.value || host.confirm(i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copye1ccbfbc14'));
host.leaves?.add(leave);
const tree = ref<AsamTreeExpose>(),
	heading = ref<HTMLElement>();
let syncing = false;
const filterNode = (value: string, data: AsamTreeNodeData) =>
	String(data.label).toLocaleLowerCase().includes(String(value).toLocaleLowerCase());
const nodeDisabled = (data: AsamTreeNodeData) =>
	!!data.disabled || !editor.writable.value || !['ready', 'saving'].includes(editor.status.value);
function checkChanged(data: TreeNode, checked: boolean) {

}

}

	[editor.selected, tree],
	async () => {

		syncing = false;

	if (await editor.open(id)) {

	}
}

	if (await editor.close()) emit('closed');

onBeforeUnmount(() => {

</script>

	<AsamConfigProvider :i18n="i18n"
		><section :aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy19ef7cab7a')">
			<div class="menu-layout">
				<aside :aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy65c625c15b')">
					<h3>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copyab15ecae10') }}</h3>
					<label
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy40729b4e7b') }}
						<AsamInput
							:model-value="filter"
							@update:model-value="
								(value) => {
									filter = String(value);
								}
							"
							v-bind="{
								'aria-label': i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy40729b4e7b')
							}"
							:size="host.size.value"
					/></label>
					<p role="status">
						{{
							error
								? i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy83cbe3dc89')
								: loading
									? i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copya83e9576a4')
									: ''
						}}
					</p>
					<AsamButton :size="host.size.value" @click="loadTree" type="primary">{{
						i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy290a22a8c9')
					}}</AsamButton
					><AsamTree
						v-if="!error"
						ref="tree"
						node-key="key"
						:data="nodes"
						default-expand-all
						:filter-node-method="filterNode"
						@node-click="locate"
					/>
				</aside>
				<AsamCrudPage
					:controller="crud"
					:field-labels="fieldLabels"
					:query-field-labels="queryLabels"
					:title="i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy174ef4f154')"
					:size="host.size.value"
					:content-width="websiteCrudWidth"
					@update:content-width="websiteSetCrudWidth"
					><template #heading
						><span>{{
							i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy6d849aa0f2')
						}}</span></template
					></AsamCrudPage

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed as websiteComputed, inject as websiteInject } from 'vue';
import type { Ref as WebsiteRef } from 'vue';
const websiteFullWidth = websiteInject<WebsiteRef<boolean> | null>(
	Symbol.for('asam.website.preview.fullWidth'),
	null
);
const websiteCrudWidth = websiteComputed(() =>
	websiteFullWidth ? (websiteFullWidth.value ? 'full' : 'contained') : undefined
);
function websiteSetCrudWidth(width: 'full' | 'contained') {
	if (websiteFullWidth) websiteFullWidth.value = width === 'full';
}

import { requiredMessage } from './i18n/Rules.js';
import { AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { administrationLabels } from './i18n/Labels.js';
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { useAdministrationI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useAdministrationI18n();
const fieldLabels = computed(() => administrationLabels(i18n, 'menus'));
const queryLabels = computed(() => administrationLabels(i18n));
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInput, AsamTree, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTreeExpose, AsamTreeNodeData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamCrudPage } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import { useAdministration, useAdministrationCrud, field, readHostOptions } from './Crud.js';
import { menuCodec, versionField } from './Codecs.js';
import { validateTree } from './Tree.js';
import type { TreeNode } from './Tree.js';
import { scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
const host = useAdministration(),
	tree = ref<AsamTreeExpose>(),
	filter = ref(''),
	error = ref(''),
	loading = ref(false),
	nodes = shallowRef<TreeNode[]>([]);
let generation = 0,
	abort: AbortController | undefined,
	alive = true;
function clear() {
	generation++;
	nodes.value = [];
	filter.value = '';
	error.value = '';
	loading.value = false;
	const old = abort;
	abort = undefined;
	old?.abort();
}
const unsubscribe = host.security.onInvalidate(clear);
async function loadTree() {
	if (host.security.check({ permission: 'menus:read' }) !== 'allowed') return;
	const token = ++generation,
		service = host.services.value,
		epoch = host.security.state.value.epoch;
	const old = abort;
	abort = new AbortController();
	old?.abort();
	const current = () =>
		alive &&
		token === generation &&
		service === host.services.value &&
		epoch === host.security.state.value.epoch;
	if (!current()) return;
	loading.value = true;
	error.value = '';
	nodes.value = [];
	try {
		const subject = host.security.state.value.subject!;
		const data = await service.menuNodes({
			signal: abort.signal,
			isCurrent: current,
			scope: scopeKey(subject)
		});
		if (current()) nodes.value = validateTree(data);
	} catch {
		if (current()) {
			nodes.value = [];
			error.value = '菜单树读取失败或结构无效，已整次拒绝';
		}
	} finally {
		if (current()) loading.value = false;
	}
}
const parentSource = defineAsamOptions().api({
	api: async () => readHostOptions(host, 'menus', (c) => host.services.value.menuNodes(c)),
	params: null,
	transform: (r) => {
		validateTree(r);
		return r.map((n) => ({ value: n.id, label: n.title }));
	},
	fieldNames: { value: 'value', label: 'label' }
});
const fields = [
	{ key: 'parentId', kind: 'single' as const, label: '父菜单（留空为根）', source: parentSource },
	field('title', '菜单标题', requiredMessage('title')),
	field('kind', '节点种类'),
	field('permissionCode', '权限代码'),
	field('enabled', '启用状态'),
	field('grantable', '明确可授予'),
	versionField
];
const crud = useAdministrationCrud(
	host,
	'menus',
	host.services.value.menus.crud,
	menuCodec,
	fields,
	[
		{
			key: 'id',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.administration.fieldid');
			},
			width: 100
		},
		{
			key: 'parentId',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.administration.fieldparentColumn');
			},
			width: 100
		},
		{
			key: 'title',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.administration.fieldtitle');
			},
			width: 180
		},
		{
			key: 'kind',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.administration.fieldkindColumn');
			},
			width: 100
		},
		{
			key: 'permissionCode',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.administration.fieldpermissionCode');
			},
			width: 180
		},
		{
			key: 'enabled',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.administration.fieldenabledColumn');
			},
			width: 90
		},
		{
			key: 'version',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.administration.fieldversion');
			},
			width: 80
		}
	]
);
const filterNode = (v: string, data: AsamTreeNodeData) => String(data.label).includes(String(v));
function locate(data: TreeNode) {
	crud.list.setDraft({ ...crud.list.draft.value, keyword: data.source.title });
	void crud.list.submit();
}
watch(filter, (v) => tree.value?.filter(v));
watch(
	() => crud.refreshState.value.status,
	(s) => {
		if (s === 'success') void loadTree();
	}
);
onMounted(loadTree);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	alive = false;
	clear();
	unsubscribe();
});
defineExpose({ crud });
</script>
<style scoped>
.menu-layout {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(180px, 240px) minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: 20px;
}
aside {
	padding: 16px;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	min-width: 0;
}
aside :deep(.el-tree) {
	max-height: 420px;
	overflow: auto;
}
@media (width < 900px) {
	.menu-layout {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
}
</style>

import { useAdministrationI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import { defineComponent, getCurrentInstance, h, ref } from 'vue';
import type { PropType } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamSelectV2, defineAsamControl, getAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamSelectV2Expose, AsamValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import {
	clearAsamFieldValue,
	isAsamFieldValue,
	useAsamFieldOptions
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition, AsamFieldOptionsConfig } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

type SingleField = Extract<AsamFieldDefinition, { kind: 'single' }>;
function scalar(value: unknown): AsamValue | null | undefined {
	if (
		value == null ||
		typeof value === 'string' ||
		typeof value === 'boolean' ||
		(typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value))
	)
		return value;
	throw createAsamMessageError(
		new TypeError('角色查询模型类型不兼容'),
		'app.templates.administration.copy18e61092f1'
	);
}
export function useRoleQueryOptions(
	original: SingleField,
	config: Omit<AsamFieldOptionsConfig, 'field'>
) {
	return useAsamFieldOptions({ ...config, field: original });
}
/** Template-owned bridge. Original full-source field owns reads; V2 only renders its snapshot. */
export function createRoleQueryField(original: SingleField): AsamFieldDefinition {
	if (original.remote || !original.source)
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('角色查询需要完整候选源'),
			'app.templates.administration.copy8f1d9d8400'
		);
	const Control = defineComponent({
		name: 'AdministrationRoleQuery',
		inheritAttrs: false,
		props: {
			modelValue: { type: null as unknown as PropType<unknown> },
			session: { type: [String, Number] },
			active: { type: Boolean, default: true },
			disabled: Boolean
		},
		emits: {
			'update:modelValue': (value: unknown) => {
				void value;
				return true;
			}
		},
		setup(props, { attrs, emit, expose }) {
			const i18n = useAdministrationI18n();
			const instance = getCurrentInstance();
			if (!instance)
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'角色查询需要组件上下文',
					'app.templates.administration.copy75635e1f4b'
				);
			const data = useRoleQueryOptions(original, {
				value: () => props.modelValue,
				session: () => props.session,
				active: () => props.active,
				runtime: getAsamDataRuntime(instance.appContext.app)
			});
			const input = ref<AsamSelectV2Expose>();
			expose({ focus: () => input.value?.focus(), refresh: data.refresh });
			return () =>
				h(
					'div',
					{
						class: 'administration-role-query',
						'aria-busy': data.search.loading.value || data.resolution.loading.value
					},
					[
						h(AsamSelectV2, {
							...attrs,
							ref: input,
							modelValue: scalar(props.modelValue),
							options: data.options.value,
							valueMode: 'value',
							multiple: false,
							filterable: false,
							remote: false,
							disabled: props.disabled || !props.active,
							emptyValues: [undefined, null],
							valueOnClear: null,
							style: { width: '100%' },
							'onUpdate:modelValue': (value: unknown) =>
								emit('update:modelValue', value)
						}),
						data.search.loading.value
							? h(
									'span',
									{ role: 'status' },
									i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy28547aa58f')
								)
							: null,
						data.search.status.value === 'empty'
							? h(
									'span',
									{ role: 'status' },
									i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copydd15fad980')
								)
							: null,
						data.search.error.value
							? h('span', { role: 'alert' }, [
									i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copydd461f4dc9'),
									h(
										AsamButton,
										{ nativeType: 'button', onClick: data.search.retry },
										() => i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy37d9ba3336')
									)
								])
							: null,
						data.labelStatus.value === 'loading'
							? h(
									'span',
									{ role: 'status' },
									i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy5293380983')
								)
							: null,
						data.labelStatus.value === 'unresolved'
							? h(
									'span',
									{ role: 'status' },
									i18n.t('app.templates.administration.unresolved', {
										labels: data.labels.value
											.filter((item) => !item.resolved)
											.map((item) => item.label)
											.join('、')
									})
								)
							: null,
						data.resolution.error.value
							? h('span', { role: 'alert' }, [
									i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy9f87b0acd7'),
									h(
										AsamButton,
										{ nativeType: 'button', onClick: data.resolution.retry },
										() => i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy531ecef479')
									)
								])
							: null
					]
				);
		}
	});
	// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars -- Exclude the borrowed source and control from the display bridge.
	const { source: _source, remote: _remote, control: _control, kind: _kind, ...base } = original;
	return {
		...base,
		kind: 'custom',
		control: defineAsamControl<unknown, object>({
			component: Control,
			emptyValue: () => clearAsamFieldValue(original),
			sourceKinds: []
		}),
		isValue: (value) => isAsamFieldValue(original, value),
		emptyValue: () => clearAsamFieldValue(original),
		isEmpty: (value) => value === null,
		format: (value) => (value == null ? '—' : String(value)),
		query: (value, context) =>
			value === undefined
				? undefined
				: original.query
					? original.query(scalar(value)!, context)
					: value === null
						? undefined
						: value,
		submit: (value, context) =>
			value === undefined
				? undefined
				: original.submit
					? original.submit(scalar(value)!, context)
					: value
	};
}

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { GrantNode, Id } from './Types.js';
import { denseArray, fields, versionValue } from './Validation.js';

export const isId = (id: unknown): id is Id =>
	typeof id === 'string'
		? id.trim().length > 0
		: typeof id === 'number' && Number.isFinite(id) && !Object.is(id, -0);
/** JSON tuple preserves numeric/string identity. Never used as a backend ID. */
export function keyOf(id: Id): string {
	if (!isId(id))
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			'标识必须为非空字符串或有限数字',
			'app.templates.administration.copy996b7ff184'
		);
	return JSON.stringify([typeof id, id]);
}
export interface TreeNode {
	key: string;
	label: string;
	disabled: boolean;
	source: GrantNode;
	children: TreeNode[];
}
/** Domain input validation only. Display/check/keyboard algorithms belong to AsamTree. */
export function validateTree(nodes: readonly GrantNode[]): TreeNode[] {
	denseArray(nodes);
	const entries = new Map<Id, TreeNode>();
	for (const source of nodes) {
		fields(source, [
			'id',
			'parentId',
			'title',
			'kind',
			'permissionCode',
			'enabled',
			'grantable',
			'version'
		]);
		if (!isId(source.id) || (source.parentId !== null && !isId(source.parentId)))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'菜单标识无效',
				'app.templates.administration.copyf9cbd59f0d'
			);
		if (entries.has(source.id))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'菜单标识重复',
				'app.templates.administration.copy455b34c28c'
			);
		if (
			typeof source.title !== 'string' ||
			!source.title.trim() ||
			typeof source.kind !== 'string' ||
			!source.kind.trim() ||
			typeof source.permissionCode !== 'string' ||
			typeof source.enabled !== 'boolean' ||
			typeof source.grantable !== 'boolean'
		)
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'菜单字段无效',
				'app.templates.administration.copy27110e255f'
			);
		versionValue(source.version);
		entries.set(source.id, {
			key: keyOf(source.id),
			label: source.title,
			disabled: !source.enabled || !source.grantable,
			source: { ...source },
			children: []
		});
	}
	const roots: TreeNode[] = [];
	for (const item of entries.values()) {
		const seen = new Set<Id>([item.source.id]);
		let parent = item.source.parentId;
		while (parent !== null) {
			if (seen.has(parent))
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'菜单包含循环',
					'app.templates.administration.copy9ecd6bf77c'
				);
			seen.add(parent);
			const value = entries.get(parent);
			if (!value)
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'菜单包含孤立节点',
					'app.templates.administration.copy45054f2b21'
				);
			parent = value.source.parentId;
		}
		if (item.source.parentId === null) roots.push(item);
		else entries.get(item.source.parentId)!.children.push(item);
	}
	return roots;
}

import type { InjectionKey, Ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamControlSize, AsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCrudServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamWriteCoordinator, AsamTableOperationCoordinator } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
type SecurityController = ReturnType<typeof createSecurity>;

export type Id = string | number;
export type Entity = 'users' | 'roles' | 'menus';
export interface Query {
	keyword: string;
	status: string;
	role: Id | null;
	context: string;
}
export interface UserEdit {
	name: string;
	account: string;
	status: string;
	roleIds: Id[];
	context: string;
	note: string;
	version: number;
}
export interface UserRow extends UserEdit {
	id: Id;
}
export interface RoleEdit {
	name: string;
	code: string;
	enabled: string;
	members: string;
	note: string;
	context: string;
	version: number;
}
export interface RoleRow extends RoleEdit {
	id: Id;
}
export interface MenuEdit {
	parentId: Id | null;
	title: string;
	kind: string;
	permissionCode: string;
	enabled: string;
	grantable: string;
	version: number;
}
export interface MenuRow extends MenuEdit {
	id: Id;
}
export interface RoleOption {
	id: Id;
	name: string;
	enabled: boolean;
}
export interface GrantNode {
	id: Id;
	parentId: Id | null;
	title: string;
	kind: string;
	permissionCode: string;
	enabled: boolean;
	grantable: boolean;
	version: number;
}
export interface GrantSnapshot {
	subject: Id;
	scope: string;
	version: string;
	nodes: readonly GrantNode[];
	direct: readonly Id[];
	unavailable: 'preserve' | 'reject';
}
export interface Request {
	signal: AbortSignal;
	isCurrent(): boolean;
	scope: string;
}
export interface GrantOperation {
	readonly operationId: string;
	readonly subject: Id;
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly serviceVersion: string;
	readonly version: string;
	readonly direct: readonly Id[];
}
export type GrantResult =
	| { status: 'success'; version: string }
	| { status: 'failure'; reason: 'conflict' | 'validation' | 'denied' }
	| { status: 'unknown' };
export interface GrantReceipt {
	readonly operation: GrantOperation;
	status: 'confirming' | 'sending' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'unknown';
	result?: GrantResult;
}
export interface GrantService {
	load(subject: Id, request: Request): Promise<GrantSnapshot>;
	save(operation: GrantOperation, request: Request): Promise<GrantResult>;
	verify(operation: GrantOperation, request: Request): Promise<GrantResult>;
}
export interface EntityServices<Row extends object, Edit extends object> {
	crud: AsamCrudServices<Row, Query, Edit, Id>;
}
export interface AdministrationServices {
	version: string;
	users: EntityServices<UserRow, UserEdit>;
	roles: EntityServices<RoleRow, RoleEdit>;
	menus: EntityServices<MenuRow, MenuEdit>;
	roleOptions(request: Request): Promise<readonly RoleOption[]>;
	menuNodes(request: Request): Promise<readonly GrantNode[]>;
	grants: GrantService;
}
export interface AdministrationHost {
	security: Pick<SecurityController, 'state' | 'check' | 'permission' | 'onInvalidate'>;
	runtime: AsamDataRuntime;
	writes: AsamWriteCoordinator;
	operations: AsamTableOperationCoordinator;
	/** Host owned, retained across page removal and security invalidation. */
	receipts: Map<string, GrantReceipt>;
	services: Ref<AdministrationServices>;
	size: Ref<AsamControlSize>;
	confirm(message: string): Promise<boolean>;
	unknownRoles: 'preserve' | 'reject';
	leaves?: Set<() => Promise<boolean>>;
}
export const administrationKey: InjectionKey<AdministrationHost> = Symbol('asam-administration');

import { administrationMessage } from './i18n/Message.js';
import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { AsamCrudServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamWriteOperation } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamRequestContext } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AdministrationHost, Id, Query, UserEdit, UserRow, RoleOption } from './Types.js';
import { userCodec } from './Codecs.js';
import { fields, denseArray } from './Validation.js';
import { isId } from './Tree.js';

export function validateRoleOptions(options: readonly RoleOption[]): readonly RoleOption[] {
	denseArray(options);
	const ids = new Set<Id>();
	for (const option of options) {
		fields(option, ['id', 'name', 'enabled']);
		if (
			!isId(option.id) ||
			ids.has(option.id) ||
			typeof option.name !== 'string' ||
			!option.name.trim() ||
			typeof option.enabled !== 'boolean'
		)
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				'角色候选无效',
				'app.templates.administration.copyf23039c22d'
			);
		ids.add(option.id);
	}
	return options;
}

/** Policy is explicit, scoped and based on the original loaded association set. */
export function withUserRolePolicy(
	host: AdministrationHost,
	service: AsamCrudServices<UserRow, Query, UserEdit, Id>
): AsamCrudServices<UserRow, Query, UserEdit, Id> {
	const originals = new Map<string, readonly Id[]>();
	const key = (scope: string, id: Id) => JSON.stringify([scope, typeof id, id]);
	const bound = host.services.value,
		serviceVersion = bound.version,
		epoch = host.security.state.value.epoch,
		boundScope = host.runtime.scope;
	const identityCurrent = (caller: AsamRequestContext) =>
		host.runtime.isCurrent(caller) &&
		caller.scope === boundScope &&
		host.services.value === bound &&
		bound.version === serviceVersion &&
		host.security.state.value.epoch === epoch;
	const current = (caller: AsamRequestContext, write: boolean) =>
		identityCurrent(caller) &&
		host.security.check({ permission: 'users:read' }) === 'allowed' &&
		(!write || host.security.check({ permission: 'users:write', write: true }) === 'allowed') &&
		identityCurrent(caller);
	async function validate(model: Readonly<UserEdit>, caller: AsamRequestContext, id?: Id) {
		if (!current(caller, true)) return null;
		const scope = caller.scope;
		const isCurrent = () => current(caller, true);
		try {
			fields(model, ['name', 'account', 'status', 'roleIds', 'context', 'note', 'version']);
			const frozen = userCodec.decode(model);
			Object.freeze(frozen.roleIds);
			Object.freeze(frozen);
			if (!isCurrent()) return null;
			const options = validateRoleOptions(
				await bound.roleOptions({
					...caller,
					isCurrent
				})
			);
			if (!isCurrent()) return null;
			const original = id === undefined ? [] : (originals.get(key(scope, id)) ?? []);
			const unavailable = original.filter(
				(k) => !options.some((o) => Object.is(o.id, k) && o.enabled)
			);
			if (host.unknownRoles === 'reject' && unavailable.length) return null;
			if (
				frozen.roleIds.some(
					(k) =>
						!original.includes(k) &&
						!options.some((o) => Object.is(o.id, k) && o.enabled)
				)
			)
				return null;
			if (
				!isCurrent() ||
				host.services.value !== bound ||
				bound.version !== serviceVersion ||
				host.security.state.value.epoch !== epoch ||
				host.security.check({ permission: 'users:write', write: true }) !== 'allowed'
			)
				return null;
			return {
				...frozen,
				roleIds: [
					...new Set([
						...frozen.roleIds,
						...(host.unknownRoles === 'preserve' ? unavailable : [])
					])
				]
			};
		} catch {
			return null;
		}
	}
	function freezeOperation(
		operation: AsamWriteOperation,
		caller: AsamRequestContext,
		id?: Id
	): AsamWriteOperation | null {
		if (
			!current(caller, true) ||
			operation.scope !== caller.scope ||
			!operation.target ||
			operation.target.mode !== (id === undefined ? 'create' : 'edit') ||
			!Object.is(operation.target.id, id) ||
			typeof operation.target.operationId !== 'string' ||
			!operation.target.operationId
		)
			return null;
		const record = (model: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) =>
			Object.freeze({
				...model,
				...(Array.isArray(model.roleIds)
					? { roleIds: Object.freeze([...model.roleIds]) }
					: {})
			});
		return Object.freeze({
			...operation,
			target: Object.freeze({ ...operation.target }),
			input: record(operation.input),
			payload: record(operation.payload)
		});
	}
	function freezeEdit(model: UserEdit): Readonly<UserEdit> {
		Object.freeze(model.roleIds);
		return Object.freeze(model);
	}
	return {
		...service,
		async load(id, c) {
			if (!current(c, false))
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'读取上下文已失效',
					'app.templates.administration.copy85516060da'
				);
			const row = await service.load(id, c);
			if (!current(c, false))
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'读取上下文已失效',
					'app.templates.administration.copy85516060da'
				);
			fields(row, ['name', 'account', 'status', 'roleIds', 'context', 'note', 'version']);
			const edit = userCodec.decode(row);
			originals.set(key(c.scope, id), [...edit.roleIds]);
			return edit;
		},
		async create(m, o, c) {
			const operation = freezeOperation(o, c);
			const safe = await validate(m, c);
			return safe && operation && current(c, true)
				? service.create(freezeEdit(safe), operation, c)
				: administrationMessage(
						{ status: 'failure' },
						'角色候选或权限已变化，确认未发送；请检查关联策略',
						'app.templates.administration.copyc997073ced'
					);
		},
		async update(id, m, o, c) {
			const operation = freezeOperation(o, c, id);
			const safe = await validate(m, c, id);
			return safe && operation && current(c, true)
				? service.update(id, freezeEdit(safe), operation, c)
				: administrationMessage(
						{ status: 'failure' },
						'未知角色策略、候选或权限拒绝，确认未发送',
						'app.templates.administration.copyebdf27f67a'
					);
		}
	};
}

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
/** Runtime DTO boundaries reject absent/extra fields and accessors before reading values. */
export function fields(
	value: unknown,
	required: readonly string[],
	optional: readonly string[] = []
): asserts value is Record<string, unknown> {
	if (
		!value ||
		typeof value !== 'object' ||
		Array.isArray(value) ||
		![Object.prototype, null].includes(Object.getPrototypeOf(value))
	)
		throw createAsamMessageError('记录格式无效', 'app.templates.administration.copyb292573732');
	const descriptors = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(value);
	if (
		Reflect.ownKeys(value).some(
			(key) =>
				typeof key !== 'string' ||
				![...required, ...optional].includes(key) ||
				!('value' in descriptors[key]) ||
				!descriptors[key].enumerable
		) ||
		required.some((key) => !Object.hasOwn(descriptors, key))
	)
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			'记录字段缺失或不受支持',
			'app.templates.administration.copy482083c10a'
		);
}
export function stringField(value: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>, key: string): string {
	const result = value[key];

import {

const websitePreviewControls =

function websitePreviewTheme0(event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) {
	updateDark(event.detail === 'dark');
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value: unknown, type: string) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}

import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { useAdministrationI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useAdministrationI18n();
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamMessageBox, createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import {
	createAsamWriteCoordinator,
	createAsamTableOperationCoordinator
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createSecurity, scopeKey } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { SecuritySubject } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { AdministrationHost } from '../Types.js';
import AdministrationApp from '../AdministrationApp.vue';
import { createSyntheticServices } from './Fixture.js';
const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const props = defineProps<{ initialFamily?: 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'technology' }>();
const family = ref<'minimal' | 'brand' | 'technology'>(
	props.initialFamily ??
		(params.get('family') === 'brand'
			? 'brand'
			: params.get('family') === 'technology'
				? 'technology'
				: 'minimal')
);
const dark = ref(params.has('dark') || family.value === 'technology'),
	size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
const identity = ref<'editor' | 'reader' | 'denied'>('editor');

const application = ref<InstanceType<typeof AdministrationApp>>();
const outcomeLabel = (value: string) => {
	const keys = {
		success: 'app.templates.administration.outcomesuccess',
		failure: 'app.templates.administration.outcomefailure',
		conflict: 'app.templates.administration.outcomeconflict',
		'unknown-applied': 'app.templates.administration.outcomeunknown-applied',
		'unknown-unapplied': 'app.templates.administration.outcomeunknown-unapplied'
	} as const;
	return Object.hasOwn(keys, value)
		? Reflect.apply(i18n.t, i18n, [Reflect.get(keys, value)])
		: value;
};
const outcomes = ['success', 'failure', 'conflict', 'unknown-applied', 'unknown-unapplied'];
const format = ref<'directory' | 'catalog'>('directory'),
	fixture = shallowRef(createSyntheticServices());
const delayDraft = ref<number | null | undefined>(fixture.value.controls.delay);
const delayControl = computed({
	get: () => delayDraft.value,
	set: (value: number | null | undefined) => {
		delayDraft.value = value;
		fixture.value.controls.delay = value ?? 0;
	}
});
function subject(
	id: string,
	scope = { tenant: 0 as string | number | null, organization: null as string | number | null }
): SecuritySubject {
	return {
		id,
		name: id === 'editor' ? '合成编辑者' : id === 'reader' ? '合成只读者' : '合成无权者',
		roles: ['sample'],
		permissions:
			id === 'denied'
				? []
				: ['users', 'roles', 'menus'].flatMap((v) => [
						`${v}:read`,
						...(id === 'editor' ? [`${v}:write`] : [])
					]),
		scope,
		contexts: [
			{ tenant: 0, organization: null, label: '数字零空间' },
			{ tenant: '0', organization: null, label: '字符串零空间' }
		],
		expiresAt: Date.now() + 3600000,
		readOnly: id === 'reader'
	};
}
const security = createSecurity<string>({
	adapter: {
		login: async (id) => subject(id),
		restore: async () => subject(identity.value),
		refresh: async (s) => subject(String(s.id), s.scope),
		switchContext: async (s, scope) => subject(String(s.id), scope),
		logout: async () => {}
	}
});
const visibleMetrics = computed(() => {
	const state = security.state.value;
	if (state.status !== 'authenticated' || !state.subject) return null;
	const scope = scopeKey(state.subject);
	return {
		...fixture.value.metrics,
		events: fixture.value.metrics.events.filter((event) => event.scope === scope)
	};
});
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const host: AdministrationHost = {
	security,
	runtime,
	writes: createAsamWriteCoordinator(),
	operations: createAsamTableOperationCoordinator(),
	receipts: new Map(),
	services: shallowRef(fixture.value.services),
	size,
	unknownRoles: 'preserve',
	confirm: (text) =>
		AsamMessageBox.confirm(text, i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy5fd01fe08a'), {
			confirmButtonText: i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy36f33adaf0'),
			cancelButtonText: i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy2cd0f3be87'),
			closeOnClickModal: false
		}).then(
			() => true,
			() => false
		)
};
const unsubscribe = security.onInvalidate(() =>
	runtime.setScope(`invalid:${security.state.value.epoch}`)
);
const setScope = security.state;
import { watch } from 'vue';
const stop = watch(
	setScope,
	(state) => {
		if (state.subject) runtime.setScope(scopeKey(state.subject));
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
async function switchContext() {
	const s = security.state.value.subject;
	if (s)
		await security.switchContext({
			tenant: typeof s.scope.tenant === 'number' ? '0' : 0,
			organization: null
		});
}
async function login() {
	application.value?.resume('/users');
	await security.login(identity.value);
}
async function replaceService(v: unknown) {
	if (v !== 'directory' && v !== 'catalog') return;
	if (!(await host.confirm(i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy2ac206261c')))) return;
	format.value = v;
	fixture.value = createSyntheticServices(v);
	delayDraft.value = fixture.value.controls.delay;
	host.services.value = fixture.value.services;
}
onMounted(() => security.login(identity.value));
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	stop();
	unsubscribe();
	security.dispose();
	runtime.setScope('unmounted');
});

function updateFamily(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'minimal' || value === 'brand' || value === 'technology') family.value = value;
}

function updateSize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'small' || value === 'default' || value === 'big' || value === 'large')
		size.value = value;
}

function updateDark(value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'boolean') dark.value = value;
}

function updateIdentity(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'editor' || value === 'reader' || value === 'denied') identity.value = value;
}

function updateFixtureControlsOutcome(value: unknown) {
	if (
		value === 'success' ||
		value === 'failure' ||
		value === 'conflict' ||
		value === 'unknown-applied' ||
		value === 'unknown-unapplied'
	)
		fixture.value.controls.outcome = value;
}
</script>
<style scoped>
.fixture-controls {
	padding: 16px;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #222);
}
label {
	margin-right: 12px;
}
output {
	display: block;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	font-size: 11px;
	max-height: 160px;
	overflow: auto;
}

ts
import { reactive } from 'vue';
import type { AsamCrudServices } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type {
	AdministrationServices,
	Entity,
	GrantNode,
	GrantOperation,
	GrantResult,
	GrantSnapshot,
	Id,
	MenuRow,
	Query,
	RoleRow,
	UserRow
} from '../Types.js';
import { directoryUser, catalogUser } from '../Codecs.js';
import { validateTree } from '../Tree.js';

export type Outcome = 'success' | 'failure' | 'conflict' | 'unknown-applied' | 'unknown-unapplied';
/** Fully local synthetic service. No endpoint, credentials or real account writes. */
export function createSyntheticServices(format: 'directory' | 'catalog' = 'directory') {
	const controls = reactive({
		delay: 100,
		readError: false,
		refreshError: false,
		outcome: 'success' as Outcome,
		verifyUnknown: false,
		malformedTree: false,
		partial: false,
		label: '合成用户',
		unknownRoles: 'preserve' as 'preserve' | 'reject'
	});
	const metrics = reactive({
		pending: 0,
		reads: 0,
		creates: 0,
		updates: 0,
		removes: 0,
		grants: 0,
		verifies: 0,
		events: [] as {
			name: string;
			start: number;
			end: number;
			scope: string;
			operationId?: string;
		}[]
	});
	let next = 1000;
	const stores = new Map<
		string,
		{ users: Map<Id, UserRow>; roles: Map<Id, RoleRow>; menus: Map<Id, MenuRow> }
	>();
	const writeResults = new Map<string, boolean>(),
		removeResults = new Map<string, boolean>();
	const grantStores = new Map<string, { version: number; direct: Id[] }>(),
		grantResults = new Map<string, GrantResult>();
	const identity = (...parts: unknown[]) => JSON.stringify(parts);
	const idAt = (i: number): Id => (i === 1 ? '0' : i);
	function store(scope: string) {
		let data = stores.get(scope);
		if (!data) {
			data = {
				users: new Map(
					Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => {
						// Both actual DTO adapters participate in ordinary service list/load/write.
						const m = {
							name: `${controls.label}${i}`,
							account: `member-${i}`,
							status: i % 3 ? '启用' : '停用',
							roleIds: [idAt(i % 30)],
							context: '示例空间',
							note: '可替换的合成资料',
							version: 1
						};
						const row =
							format === 'directory'
								? directoryUser.from({ uid: idAt(i), ...directoryUser.to(m) })
								: catalogUser.from({ key: idAt(i), ...catalogUser.to(m) });
						return [row.id, row];
					})
				),
				roles: new Map(
					Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => [
						idAt(i),
						{
							id: idAt(i),
							name: `协作角色${i}`,
							code: `role-${i}`,
							enabled: '启用',
							members: `${i + 2} 项合成引用（后端最终裁决）`,
							note: '仅前端展示关联',
							context: '示例空间',
							version: 1
						}
					])
				),
				menus: new Map(
					Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, i) => [
						idAt(i),
						{
							id: idAt(i),
							parentId: i === 0 ? null : idAt(Math.floor((i - 1) / 3)),
							title: `权限节点${i}`,
							kind: i < 17 ? '结构' : '操作',
							permissionCode: `sample:${i}`,
							enabled: i % 9 === 0 ? '停用' : '启用',
							grantable: i < 17 ? '否' : '是',
							version: 1
						}
					])
				)
			};
			stores.set(scope, data);
		}
		return data;
	}
	async function wait(name: string, scope: string, operationId?: string) {
		metrics.pending++;
		const event = { name, scope, operationId, start: performance.now(), end: 0 };
		await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, controls.delay));
		metrics.pending--;
		event.end = performance.now();
		metrics.events.push(event);
	}
	function nodes(scope: string): GrantNode[] {
		return [...store(scope).menus.values()].map((n) => ({
			...n,
			enabled: n.enabled === '启用',
			grantable: n.grantable === '是'
		}));
	}
	function generic<Row extends { id: Id; version: number }, Edit extends { version: number }>(
		entity: Entity,
		rows: (scope: string) => Map<Id, Row>,
		defaults: () => Edit,
		normalize?: (edit: Readonly<Edit>, id: Id) => Row
	): AsamCrudServices<Row, Query, Edit, Id> {
		async function save(model: Readonly<Edit>, scope: string, operationId: string, id?: Id) {
			const mode = controls.outcome,
				key = id ?? ++next;
			await wait(`${entity}:${id === undefined ? 'create' : 'update'}`, scope, operationId);
			const previous = rows(scope).get(key);
			if (mode === 'failure')
				return {
					status: 'failure' as const,
					message: '服务确认拒绝，未应用',
					issues: [
						{ key: entity === 'menus' ? 'title' : 'name', message: '请检查输入名称' }
					]
				};
			if (
				mode === 'conflict' ||
				(id !== undefined && (!previous || previous.version !== model.version))
			)
				return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '版本冲突，确认未应用；请重新加载' };
			if (entity === 'users') {
				const m = model as unknown as UserRow;
				if (
					controls.unknownRoles === 'reject' &&
					m.roleIds.some((k) => !store(scope).roles.has(k))
				)
					return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '服务策略拒绝未知角色，未应用' };
			}
			let row: Row;
			try {
				row = normalize ? normalize(model, key) : ({ ...model, id: key } as unknown as Row);
			} catch {
				return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '字段映射无效，确认未应用' };
			}
			row.version = (previous?.version ?? 0) + 1;
			if (entity === 'menus') {
				try {
					const all = new Map(store(scope).menus);
					all.set(key, row as unknown as MenuRow);
					validateTree(
						[...all.values()].map((n) => ({
							...n,
							enabled: n.enabled === '启用',
							grantable: n.grantable === '是'
						}))
					);
				} catch {
					return { status: 'failure' as const, message: '菜单结构无效，确认未应用' };
				}
			}
			const applied = mode !== 'unknown-unapplied';
			if (applied) rows(scope).set(key, structuredClone(row));
			writeResults.set(identity(scope, operationId), applied);
			if (controls.refreshError) controls.readError = true;
			return mode.startsWith('unknown')
				? { status: 'unknown' as const, message: '响应未知，请核实原操作' }
				: { status: 'success' as const, data: { id: key } };
		}
		return {
			async list(q, c) {
				metrics.reads++;
				const snapshot = [...rows(c.scope).values()].map((r) => structuredClone(r));
				await wait(`${entity}:list`, c.scope);
				if (controls.readError) throw new Error('模拟读取失败');
				const result = snapshot.filter((r) => {
					const m = r as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
					return (
						(!q.query.keyword ||
							String(m.name ?? m.title).includes(q.query.keyword) ||
							String(m.account ?? m.code ?? '').includes(q.query.keyword)) &&
						(!q.query.status || String(m.status ?? m.enabled) === q.query.status) &&
						(q.query.role === null ||

						(!q.query.context || String(m.context ?? '').includes(q.query.context))
					);
				});

					list: result.slice(
						(q.currentPage - 1) * q.pageSize,
						q.currentPage * q.pageSize

					total: result.length

			async defaults(c) {

				if (!row) throw new Error('记录不存在');

				const { id: _id, ...edit } = row;

			create(m, o, c) {
				metrics.creates++;

			},

				metrics.updates++;
				return save(m, c.scope, o.target.operationId, k);
			},
			async verify(o) {
				metrics.verifies++;
				await wait(`${entity}:verify`, o.scope, o.target.operationId);
				return controls.verifyUnknown
					? { status: 'unknown' }
					: writeResults.get(identity(o.scope, o.target.operationId))
						? { status: 'success' }
						: { status: 'not-applied' };
			},
			async resolve(keys, c) {
				return keys.map((key) => {
					const r = rows(c.scope).get(key);
					return r
						? {
								key,
								target: {
									key,
									version: String(r.version),

								}

			note: '',

		() => ({

			code: '',

			context: '示例空间',
			version: 0

		(s) => store(s).menus,

			title: '',
			kind: '操作',

			grantStores.set(key, record);
		}

	}

		menus: { crud: menus },

				name: n.name,
				enabled: n.enabled === '启用'

		},

			await wait('menus:tree', r.scope);
			if (controls.readError) throw new Error('模拟读取失败');

		},
		grants: {

					v = record.version;

					subject,
					scope: r.scope,
					version: String(v),
					direct,

				};

				if (mode === 'conflict' || String(record.version) !== op.version)
					return { status: 'failure', reason: 'conflict' };
				const previous = record.direct.filter(
					(id) =>
						!nodes(op.scope).some(
							(n) => Object.is(n.id, id) && n.enabled && n.grantable
						)
				);
				if (
					previous.some((id) => !op.direct.includes(id)) ||
					op.direct.some(
						(id) =>
							!record.direct.includes(id) &&
							!nodes(op.scope).some(
								(n) => Object.is(n.id, id) && n.enabled && n.grantable
							)
					)
				)
					return { status: 'failure', reason: 'validation' };
				if (mode !== 'unknown-unapplied') applyGrant(op, record);

					mode === 'unknown-unapplied'
						? { status: 'failure', reason: 'validation' }

			},
			async verify(op, r) {
				metrics.verifies++;

					? { status: 'unknown' }
					: (grantResults.get(op.operationId) ?? { status: 'unknown' });
			}
		}
	};
	return { services, controls, metrics };
}

import { createApp, h } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from './App.vue';
export async function mountAdministration(initialFamily?: 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'technology') {
	if (initialFamily && location.pathname.endsWith('.html'))
		history.replaceState(null, '', `/?family=${initialFamily}`);
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createWebHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/', component: { render: () => h('div') } },
			{ path: '/safe', component: { render: () => h('div') } }
		]
	});
	const application = createApp(App, { initialFamily }).use(router);
	await router.isReady();
	return application.mount('#app');
}

export function administrationLabels(
	scope: AsamI18n,
	entity?: Entity
): Readonly<Record<string, string>> {
	const source = entity ? entities[entity] : query;

import type { AsamI18nCall } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';

export function administrationMessage<const T extends object>(
	value: T,
	legacy: string,
	...call: AsamI18nCall
): T & { readonly message: string } {
	return Object.assign(createAsamMessageIssue(legacy, ...call), value);
