.administration {
	--admin-gap: var(--asam-space-6, 24px);
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 240px minmax(0, 1fr);
	grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
	min-height: 100%;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-page, #f7f6f3);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #242924);
	font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
}
.administration * {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.administration .brand {
	grid-row: 1 / -1;
	padding: 40px 28px;
	border-right: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border, #ddd);
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 32px;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
}
.administration .brand h1 {
	font-size: 28px;
	line-height: 1.35;
	margin: 0;
	letter-spacing: -0.025em;
}
.administration .brand p {
	font-size: 12px;
	line-height: 1.7;
	letter-spacing: 0.09em;
}
.administration .brand-mark {
	font-size: 42px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: -0.08em;
}
.administration .brand-note {
	margin-top: auto;
}
.administration .topbar {
	padding: 20px var(--admin-gap);
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 12px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
}
.administration nav {
	padding: 16px var(--admin-gap);
	display: flex;
	gap: 8px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.administration main {
	padding: 0 var(--admin-gap) var(--admin-gap);
	min-width: 0;
}
.administration footer {
	padding: 16px var(--admin-gap);
	font-size: 12px;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 8px;
}
.administration .safe {
	padding: 40px 24px;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
}
.administration[data-family='minimal'] {
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.administration[data-family='minimal'] .brand {
	grid-row: auto;
	flex-direction: row;
	align-items: center;
	padding: 24px max(24px, calc((100vw - 1400px) / 2));
	border: 0;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	gap: 24px;
}
.administration[data-family='minimal'] .brand h1 {
	font-family: Georgia, 'Microsoft YaHei', serif;
	font-size: 32px;
}
.administration[data-family='minimal'] .brand-note {
	margin: 0 0 0 auto;
}
.administration[data-family='brand'] {
	grid-template-columns: 270px minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.administration[data-family='brand'] .brand {
	background: var(--asam-semantic-brand-surface);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-brand-foreground);
	justify-content: center;
}
.administration[data-family='brand'] .brand h1 {
	font-size: 40px;
	max-width: 5em;
}
.administration[data-family='brand'] .brand-mark {
	font-size: 72px;
	border-top: 2px solid currentColor;
	padding-top: 24px;
}
.administration[data-family='technology'] {
	grid-template-columns: 100px minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.administration[data-family='technology'] .brand {
	padding: 24px 12px;
	gap: 48px;
	align-items: center;
}
.administration[data-family='technology'] .brand h1 {
	writing-mode: vertical-rl;
	font-size: 24px;
	letter-spacing: 0.2em;
}
.administration[data-family='technology'] .brand p {
	display: none;
}
.administration[data-family='technology'] .topbar {
	font-family: Consolas, monospace;
	border-top: 3px solid var(--asam-color-primary);
}
.administration button:not([class*='el-']) {
	transition:
		transform 120ms,
		color 120ms;
}
.administration button:not([class*='el-']):active {
	transform: translateY(1px);
}
/* Readiness changes are immediate; only deliberate interactions animate. */
.administration[data-family] .asam-button {
	transition: none;
}
.administration[data-family] .el-checkbox .el-checkbox__inner,
.administration[data-family] .el-pagination button:not([class*='el-']) {
	transition: none;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.administration[data-family] .asam-button:is(:hover, :focus-visible, :active) {
		transition:
			transform 120ms,
			color 120ms;
	}
}
.administration :focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--asam-color-primary, #4c7fec);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.administration .skip {
	position: fixed;
	top: -60px;
	left: 12px;
	z-index: 10;
	padding: 12px;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary);
}
.administration .skip:focus {
	top: 12px;
}
@media (width < 700px) {
	.administration,
	.administration[data-family] {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
		--admin-gap: 12px;
	}
	.administration[data-family] .brand {
		grid-row: auto;
		flex-direction: row;
		padding: 16px;
		gap: 16px;
		align-items: center;
	}
	.administration[data-family] .brand h1 {
		font-size: 24px;
		writing-mode: horizontal-tb;
		max-width: none;
	}
	.administration[data-family] .brand-mark {
		font-size: 36px;
		padding: 0;
		border: 0;
	}
	.administration .brand-note {
		display: none;
	}
	.administration .topbar {
		padding: 12px;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.administration button:not([class*='el-']) {
		transition: none;
		transform: none;
	}
}

let sequence = 0;
let fallbackPrefix: string | undefined;

/** 模板的操作关联ID和行键；不依赖DOM或安全上下文，也不用于安全凭据。 */
export function createTemplateId(): string {
	const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
	if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
	if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues === 'function') {
		const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
		bytes[6] = (bytes[6]! & 0x0f) | 0x40;
		bytes[8] = (bytes[8]! & 0x3f) | 0x80;
		const hex = [...bytes].map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
		return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
	}
	// 无Web Crypto的SSR宿主仍能创建本模块内独立关联键，不在导入时访问浏览器对象。
	fallbackPrefix ??= `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
	return `asam-${fallbackPrefix}-${(++sequence).toString(36)}`;
}

import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp, h } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from '../templates/administration/examples/App.vue';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(element, onError, i18n, options) {
	const apps = [];
	const createApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		if (options?.fullWidth)
			app.provide(Symbol.for('asam.website.preview.fullWidth'), options.fullWidth);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};
	async function mountAdministration(initialFamily) {
		if (initialFamily && location.pathname.endsWith('.html'))
			history.replaceState(null, '', `/?family=${initialFamily}`);
		const router = createRouter({
			history: createWebHistory(),
			routes: [
				{ path: '/', component: { render: () => h('div') } },
				{ path: '/safe', component: { render: () => h('div') } }
			]
		});
		const application = createApp(App, { initialFamily }).use(router);
		await router.isReady();
		return application.mount(element);
	}
	await mountAdministration();
	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

<script setup>
import { useAdministrationI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useAdministrationI18n();
import { nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, provide, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { RouterView, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createSecurityNavigation } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { administrationKey } from './Types.js';
import UsersPage from './UsersPage.vue';
import RolesPage from './RolesPage.vue';
import MenusPage from './MenusPage.vue';
import './styles.css';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	family: { type: String, required: false, default: 'minimal' },
	mode: { type: String, required: false, default: 'light' }
});
const securityStatus = (value) => {
	const keys = {
		anonymous: 'app.templates.administration.securityanonymous',
		restoring: 'app.templates.administration.securityrestoring',
		authenticating: 'app.templates.administration.securityauthenticating',
		refreshing: 'app.templates.administration.securityrefreshing',
		switching: 'app.templates.administration.securityswitching',
		authenticated: 'app.templates.administration.securityauthenticated',
		expired: 'app.templates.administration.securityexpired',
		error: 'app.templates.administration.securityerror',
		'logging-out': 'app.templates.administration.securitylogging-out',
		disposed: 'app.templates.administration.securitydisposed'
	};
	return i18n.enabled.value ? i18n.t(keys[value]) : value;
};
const router = useRouter(),
	content = ref(),
	leaves = new Set();
const serviceGeneration = ref(0);
function currentAttributes(path) {
	return { 'aria-current': router.currentRoute.value.path === path ? 'page' : undefined };
}
provide(administrationKey, { ...props.host, leaves });
// Router START_LOCATION is '/' even when a normal host is beginning a deep-link navigation.
const initialLocation = router.options.history.location || router.currentRoute.value.fullPath;
const bridge = createSecurityNavigation({
	i18n,
	security: props.host.security,
	router,
	components: { users: UsersPage, roles: RolesPage, menus: MenusPage },
	items: [
		{ id: 'users', title: '用户管理', path: '/users', resource: 'users', cache: false },

						administrationMessage(
							{ key: t.key, status: 'failure' },

<script setup>

		><section :aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.administration.copy19ef7cab7a')">

<script setup>
import { computed as websiteComputed, inject as websiteInject } from 'vue';

	field('kind', '节点种类'),

	[

			},
			width: 100

		{
			key: 'parentId',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.administration.fieldparentColumn');
			},
			width: 100
		},
		{
			key: 'title',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.administration.fieldtitle');
			},
			width: 180

		{
			key: 'kind',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.administration.fieldkindColumn');
			},
			width: 100

		{
			key: 'permissionCode',
			get label() {

import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { directoryUser, catalogUser } from '../Codecs.js';
import { validateTree } from '../Tree.js';
/** Fully local synthetic service. No endpoint, credentials or real account writes. */
export function createSyntheticServices(format = 'directory') {
	const controls = reactive({
		delay: 100,
		readError: false,
		refreshError: false,
		outcome: 'success',
		verifyUnknown: false,
		malformedTree: false,
		partial: false,
		label: '合成用户',
		unknownRoles: 'preserve'
	});
	const metrics = reactive({
		pending: 0,
		reads: 0,
		creates: 0,
		updates: 0,
		removes: 0,
		grants: 0,
		verifies: 0,
		events: []
	});
	let next = 1000;
	const stores = new Map();
	const writeResults = new Map(),
		removeResults = new Map();
	const grantStores = new Map(),
		grantResults = new Map();
	const identity = (...parts) => JSON.stringify(parts);
	const idAt = (i) => (i === 1 ? '0' : i);
	function store(scope) {
		let data = stores.get(scope);
		if (!data) {
			data = {
				users: new Map(
					Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => {
						// Both actual DTO adapters participate in ordinary service list/load/write.
						const m = {
							name: `${controls.label}${i}`,
							account: `member-${i}`,
							status: i % 3 ? '启用' : '停用',
							roleIds: [idAt(i % 30)],
							context: '示例空间',
							note: '可替换的合成资料',
							version: 1
						};
						const row =
							format === 'directory'
								? directoryUser.from({ uid: idAt(i), ...directoryUser.to(m) })
								: catalogUser.from({ key: idAt(i), ...catalogUser.to(m) });
						return [row.id, row];
					})
				),
				roles: new Map(
					Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => [
						idAt(i),
						{
							id: idAt(i),
							name: `协作角色${i}`,
							code: `role-${i}`,
							enabled: '启用',
							members: `${i + 2} 项合成引用（后端最终裁决）`,
							note: '仅前端展示关联',
							context: '示例空间',
							version: 1
						}
					])
				),
				menus: new Map(
					Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, i) => [
						idAt(i),
						{
							id: idAt(i),
							parentId: i === 0 ? null : idAt(Math.floor((i - 1) / 3)),
							title: `权限节点${i}`,
							kind: i < 17 ? '结构' : '操作',
							permissionCode: `sample:${i}`,
							enabled: i % 9 === 0 ? '停用' : '启用',
							grantable: i < 17 ? '否' : '是',
							version: 1
						}
					])
				)
			};
			stores.set(scope, data);
		}
		return data;
	}
	async function wait(name, scope, operationId) {
		metrics.pending++;
		const event = { name, scope, operationId, start: performance.now(), end: 0 };
		await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, controls.delay));
		metrics.pending--;
		event.end = performance.now();
		metrics.events.push(event);
	}
	function nodes(scope) {
		return [...store(scope).menus.values()].map((n) => ({
			...n,
			enabled: n.enabled === '启用',
			grantable: n.grantable === '是'
		}));
	}
	function generic(entity, rows, defaults, normalize) {
		async function save(model, scope, operationId, id) {
			const mode = controls.outcome,
				key = id ?? ++next;
			await wait(`${entity}:${id === undefined ? 'create' : 'update'}`, scope, operationId);
			const previous = rows(scope).get(key);
			if (mode === 'failure')
				return {
					status: 'failure',
					message: '服务确认拒绝，未应用',
					issues: [
						{ key: entity === 'menus' ? 'title' : 'name', message: '请检查输入名称' }
					]
				};
			if (
				mode === 'conflict' ||
				(id !== undefined && (!previous || previous.version !== model.version))
			)
				return { status: 'failure', message: '版本冲突，确认未应用；请重新加载' };
			if (entity === 'users') {
				const m = model;
				if (
					controls.unknownRoles === 'reject' &&
					m.roleIds.some((k) => !store(scope).roles.has(k))
				)
					return { status: 'failure', message: '服务策略拒绝未知角色，未应用' };
			}
			let row;
			try {
				row = normalize ? normalize(model, key) : { ...model, id: key };
			} catch {
				return { status: 'failure', message: '字段映射无效，确认未应用' };
			}
			row.version = (previous?.version ?? 0) + 1;
			if (entity === 'menus') {

import { createApp, h } from 'vue';

export async function mountAdministration(initialFamily) {
	if (initialFamily && location.pathname.endsWith('.html'))
		history.replaceState(null, '', `/?family=${initialFamily}`);

		history: createWebHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/', component: { render: () => h('div') } },
			{ path: '/safe', component: { render: () => h('div') } }
		]
	});

	await router.isReady();

}

css
.administration {
	--admin-gap: var(--asam-space-6, 24px);
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 240px minmax(0, 1fr);
	grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
	min-height: 100%;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface-page, #f7f6f3);
	color: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #242924);
	font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
}
.administration * {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.administration .brand {
	grid-row: 1 / -1;
	padding: 40px 28px;
	border-right: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border, #ddd);
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 32px;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
}
.administration .brand h1 {
	font-size: 28px;
	line-height: 1.35;
	margin: 0;
	letter-spacing: -0.025em;
}
.administration .brand p {
	font-size: 12px;
	line-height: 1.7;
	letter-spacing: 0.09em;
}
.administration .brand-mark {
	font-size: 42px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: -0.08em;
}
.administration .brand-note {
	margin-top: auto;
}
.administration .topbar {
	padding: 20px var(--admin-gap);
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 12px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
}
.administration nav {
	padding: 16px var(--admin-gap);
	display: flex;
	gap: 8px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.administration main {
	padding: 0 var(--admin-gap) var(--admin-gap);
	min-width: 0;
}
.administration footer {
	padding: 16px var(--admin-gap);
	font-size: 12px;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 8px;
}
.administration .safe {
	padding: 40px 24px;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
}
.administration[data-family='minimal'] {
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.administration[data-family='minimal'] .brand {
	grid-row: auto;
	flex-direction: row;
	align-items: center;
	padding: 24px max(24px, calc((100vw - 1400px) / 2));
	border: 0;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	gap: 24px;
}
.administration[data-family='minimal'] .brand h1 {
	font-family: Georgia, 'Microsoft YaHei', serif;
	font-size: 32px;
}
.administration[data-family='minimal'] .brand-note {
	margin: 0 0 0 auto;
}
.administration[data-family='brand'] {
	grid-template-columns: 270px minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.administration[data-family='brand'] .brand {
	background: var(--asam-semantic-brand-surface);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-brand-foreground);
	justify-content: center;
}
.administration[data-family='brand'] .brand h1 {
	font-size: 40px;
	max-width: 5em;
}
.administration[data-family='brand'] .brand-mark {
	font-size: 72px;
	border-top: 2px solid currentColor;
	padding-top: 24px;
}
.administration[data-family='technology'] {
	grid-template-columns: 100px minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.administration[data-family='technology'] .brand {
	padding: 24px 12px;
	gap: 48px;
	align-items: center;
}
.administration[data-family='technology'] .brand h1 {
	writing-mode: vertical-rl;
	font-size: 24px;
	letter-spacing: 0.2em;
}
.administration[data-family='technology'] .brand p {

}

.administration[data-family] .el-pagination button:not([class*='el-']) {

js
let sequence = 0;
let fallbackPrefix;
/** 模板的操作关联ID和行键；不依赖DOM或安全上下文，也不用于安全凭据。 */
export function createTemplateId() {
	const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
	if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
	if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues === 'function') {
		const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
		bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
		bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
		const hex = [...bytes].map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
		return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
	}
	// 无Web Crypto的SSR宿主仍能创建本模块内独立关联键，不在导入时访问浏览器对象。
	fallbackPrefix ??= `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
	return `asam-${fallbackPrefix}-${(++sequence).toString(36)}`;
}

组织用户、角色、菜单和直接授权集合。

使用与 API

本目录通过完整应用源码接入，按下方接口与行为说明提供宿主依赖。

完整示例

独立挂载入口：website-hosts/administration.ts。复制全部依赖文件，按接入说明加载三份公共样式后，调用该入口导出的 await mountWebsiteExample(element, onError)，并在页面销毁时调用返回的释放函数。这个入口保留原示例的 router、provider 和上下文注入，不能只复制 App.vue。

示例使用本地演示数据，不连接真实管理后端。

继续接入

快速开始 · 版本与迁移 · AI 开发说明

接口、行为与迁移细节

接口与行为

类型权威为 Types.ts，所有 .vue、配方与同版文档一起复制。

运行时 Edit/Query/GrantNode 与示例 DTO 使用完整字段白名单：缺字段、额外字段、非法类型、访问器、重复或稀疏 ID 集合整次拒绝。版本不默认补零；parentId 必须显式为 null 或有效 typed ID。queryProjectionCodec 是唯一列表适配入口，仅补 列表控制器 明确省略的空查询值，随后仍调用完整 Query 校验。Row→Edit 由宿主显式投影，不能把含 id 或后端私有字段的 Row 直接当 Edit。 跨实例核实回执只推进已授基线，不吞本实例 dirty 草稿；只有本实例原操作且无后继修改，才能用该操作快照更新选中集合。示例提供实际 logout，bootstrap 等 router 初始导航就绪后建立 bridge 以保持深链。

协议 输入 / 输出与职责
AdministrationHost 宿主 security/runtime/writes/operations/receipts/services/size/confirm/unknownRoles；只借用
AdministrationServices version，三组 AsamCrudServices，roleOptions、menuNodes、grants；无内置 URL
Query keyword/status/role/context；role 为 typed Id 或 null
UserEdit / UserRow name/account/status/roleIds/context/note/version，Row 另有 id
RoleEdit / RoleRow name/code/enabled/members/note/context/version，Row 另有 id；members 只读含义由宿主定义
MenuEdit / MenuRow parentId/title/kind/permissionCode/enabled/grantable/version，Row 另有 id
GrantNode typed id/parentId/title/kind/permissionCode/enabled/grantable/version
GrantSnapshot subject/scope/version/nodes/direct/unavailable；只读完整输入
GrantOperation operationId/subject/scope/serviceVersion/version/direct；冻结原操作
GrantService load(subject,Request)、save(operation,Request)、verify(operation,Request)
Request signal/isCurrent/scope；服务写副作用由宿主后端再次鉴权
GrantResult success/version；failure/reason(conflict/validation/denied，明确未应用)；unknown
GrantReceipt 原 operation、sending/success/failure/unknown 与 result；Map 由宿主跨卸载保存
GrantEditor expose open(typedId)、editor；关闭发 closed；自身卸载只清本地状态
createGrantEditor snapshot/selected/filter/status/message/dirty/tree/visible/writable refs；open/toggle/selectVisible/save/verify/close/reload/invalidate/dispose
AdministrationApp host，family(minimal/brand/technology)，mode(light/dark)；controls/recovery slots；navigation expose

CRUD 公开能力沿用 增删改查组件 原协议，不能通过这里绕过原 controller。详情读取当前服务，失效原 Row 不再发起编辑。 各服务 DTO 必须经显式 codec 转成展示安全字段。version 字段参与隐藏编辑提交，不由 UI 猜后端 etag。 纯字符串状态是示例显示协议；换布尔、枚举、数值后端用 codec 显式转换。

GrantEditor status：closed→loading→ready/error；ready→saving→ready/unknown；unknown→verifying→ready/unknown。 失效优先 closed，不等用户确认。读取失败不保留半树。刷新 dirty 先确认；保存中的后继修改不会被旧成功覆盖。 confirmed failure 可显式更正后再次保存；unknown 只核实原操作。

迁移

这是新增模板，没有删除既有包接口。复制模板目录及 导航模板/会话与权限模板 的相对依赖；保留正常包 import。 从旧管理页迁入时逐项替换：

  1. 将 Row/Edit/Query 映射到 Types.ts；使用明确 codec 保留原 typed ID、版本与原始服务映射。
  2. 注入三组 AsamCrudServices 和应用持有的 writes/operations，不把各页未决写放到临时组件内。
  3. 接入宿主 SecurityAdapter 与 scopeKey。给每个 route 明确读取规则，写前单独检查权限；禁用通配超级角色推导。
  4. 将后端授权模型转换为 direct 集合，明确全量/差额、不可授保留/拒绝、版本与 unknown 核实策略。
  5. 服务替换更改 version 和服务引用；失效优先清数据。普通离开可以询问丢弃，安全失效不能让确认保留旧主体。
  6. 删除旧“失败自动重试写”的流程；对 unknown 使用原 operationId 核实。

Directory/Catalog 的真实可运行合成映射见 Codecs.ts 与 Fixture.ts。 真实后端授权引擎、认证服务器、租户平台及真实 CL 页面不属于本模板，接入方保留这些职责。

Edit/Query/GrantNode 与示例 DTO 的字段必须完整且无额外字段；service.load 显式返回 Edit，不把含 id 的 Row 直接传给 Edit codec。新增字段同时更新 Types、字段定义、codec 白名单和 DTO adapter。列表控制器 空查询省略只经 queryProjectionCodec 适配，不把缺失 Edit/parentId/version 默认为合法值。保留目标工程的依赖检查配置与有效锁。

使用说明

用户管理/角色管理/菜单管理 的可编辑 Vue 3 应用模板。入口 AdministrationApp.vue，三页是 UsersPage.vue、RolesPage.vue、MenusPage.vue，授权交互为 GrantEditor.vue。 复用正常 @asam-ui/ui / @asam-ui/pro，不提供认证服务或真实 RBAC 引擎。

复制本目录和同版 app/security、app/navigation，保留相对路径。安装匹配的 UI/Pro、Vue、Element Plus 与 Vue Router，从 examples/main.ts 启动并依次加载 Element Plus、UI 与 Pro 样式。App.vue 提供本地合成宿主；业务接入时替换其 adapter。

同源应用与设计

使用 minimal.html、brand.html、technology.html 三个独立生产入口，或 ?family=minimal、?family=brand、?family=technology 启动三个完整应用外壳。 三族共享同版三页面，完整路由为 /users、/roles、/menus，公开恢复页为 /safe。 三风格的布局分别为横向编辑式目录、品牌侧栏、窄轨科技控制台；支持父级明暗、390 窄屏、 键盘焦点、40/36/32/28 四档。轻反馈仅按钮颜色与位移，减少动态时关闭，不等待入场动画才可操作。

布局与主题

简约族采用横向外壳与细分隔，品牌族强调身份和内容层次，科技族使用窄轨与深浅对比。三族保留相同数据、操作和权限协议。

项目的 Vue/ASAM、tokens、可访问性及立即可操作要求优先于上述 Skill 的视觉偏好。

宿主职责

Types.ts 定义稳定协议。宿主持有 security、runtime、writes、operations、receipts、services 和 size。 页面只释放自己的 watch/读请求/订阅/控制器；AdministrationApp 释放自己的导航 bridge/guard， 不 dispose 借入的 security/router/runtime/写协调器。examples/App.vue 因为创建了这些资源，才在卸载时释放。 每个实例使用自己的 router 和 runtime；可以借同一个 security 与宿主写回执。

权限来源为 会话与权限模板 security.check/permission；每个读取路由都有独立明确规则。 菜单隐藏仅控制展示。写前同步检查 read、write 和 readOnly，pending/error/失效关闭受限页。 会话与权限模板 失效同步清草稿和树，不通过 dirty 确认保留失效资料。宿主先切 runtime scope，再建立新页面。 服务替换由宿主明确确认；其引用及 version 参与页面代次，旧读取即使忽略 Abort 也不覆盖新页面。

默认合成字段不是用户指定的 CL 业务：100 用户、30 角色、50 节点、20 条/页、4 查询条件、 6 编辑字段，100ms 受控读取。没有真实密码、真实端点、超级管理员或通配符推导。 原始异常不直接展示。adapter 返回的消息/字段错误必须已经是展示安全内容，不能携带后端原异常或凭据。

写入与恢复

CRUD 用 增删改查组件 useAsamCrudController/AsamCrudPage/AsamCrudServices。版本随编辑 payload、删除目标冻结； 服务确认未应用才是 failure；无法确定是 unknown。unknown 保留原 operationId，仅核实，不自动重发。 删除逐目标保留结果；写成功而列表刷新失败时只重试列表，不重复写。

授权是 direct grant 集合，不推导继承权限。树勾选使用 check-strictly；结构父节点/禁用节点不新增， 过滤不丢隐藏项。未知或当前不可授的旧 grant 按 load 返回的 unavailable preserve/reject 策略处理。 preserve 项在摘要中可见且不能被“取消可见”静默清除。相同 scope/对象的未决回执阻止换 ID 重发。 保存期间可以继续修改树；成功回执只更新所发快照，后继草稿继续 dirty。确认前、调用前、异步后核当前代次。 离开范围后仍留 host.receipts，宿主可用原 serviceVersion 对原操作核实。

菜单树在显示前整体验证重复、孤儿、循环与非法 typed ID，坏输入整次拒绝。UI key 用类型化 JSON tuple， 回传仍为原 ID；数字 0 和字符串 '0'、根 null 分开。树行为由原生 AsamTree 实现。

两种宿主适配

Codecs.ts 的 DirectoryUserDTO 与 CatalogUserDTO 字段结构不同；examples/Fixture.ts 分别实际用这两种映射读取/写入。Directory 保存全量 grant，Catalog 明确计算 set 差额；UI API 保持同一集合协议。 替换时实现 AdministrationServices，自行适配 DTO/版本/服务鉴权/引用限制；不在 UI 内猜 URL 或授权规则。 角色候选来自 roleOptions，未知用户角色按宿主 unknownRoles 策略保留或拒绝，不从候选缺失推断新增授权。

修改步骤和验证入口见 AGENT.md、API.md、Migration.md。

完整类型

Types.ts · 完整类型
ts
import type { InjectionKey, Ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamControlSize, AsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamCrudServices,
	AsamWriteCoordinator,
	AsamTableOperationCoordinator
} from '@asam-ui/pro';
import type { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
type SecurityController = ReturnType<typeof createSecurity>;

export type Id = string | number;
export type Entity = 'users' | 'roles' | 'menus';
export interface Query {
	keyword: string;
	status: string;
	role: Id | null;
	context: string;
}
export interface UserEdit {
	name: string;
	account: string;
	status: string;
	roleIds: Id[];
	context: string;
	note: string;
	version: number;
}
export interface UserRow extends UserEdit {
	id: Id;
}
export interface RoleEdit {
	name: string;
	code: string;
	enabled: string;
	members: string;
	note: string;
	context: string;
	version: number;
}
export interface RoleRow extends RoleEdit {
	id: Id;
}
export interface MenuEdit {
	parentId: Id | null;
	title: string;
	kind: string;
	permissionCode: string;
	enabled: string;
	grantable: string;
	version: number;
}
export interface MenuRow extends MenuEdit {
	id: Id;
}
export interface RoleOption {
	id: Id;
	name: string;
	enabled: boolean;
}
export interface GrantNode {
	id: Id;
	parentId: Id | null;
	title: string;
	kind: string;
	permissionCode: string;
	enabled: boolean;
	grantable: boolean;
	version: number;
}
export interface GrantSnapshot {
	subject: Id;
	scope: string;
	version: string;
	nodes: readonly GrantNode[];
	direct: readonly Id[];
	unavailable: 'preserve' | 'reject';
}
export interface Request {
	signal: AbortSignal;
	isCurrent(): boolean;
	scope: string;
}
export interface GrantOperation {
	readonly operationId: string;
	readonly subject: Id;
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly serviceVersion: string;
	readonly version: string;
	readonly direct: readonly Id[];
}
export type GrantResult =
	| { status: 'success'; version: string }
	| { status: 'failure'; reason: 'conflict' | 'validation' | 'denied' }
	| { status: 'unknown' };
export interface GrantReceipt {
	readonly operation: GrantOperation;
	status: 'confirming' | 'sending' | 'success' | 'failure' | 'unknown';
	result?: GrantResult;
}
export interface GrantService {
	load(subject: Id, request: Request): Promise<GrantSnapshot>;
	save(operation: GrantOperation, request: Request): Promise<GrantResult>;
	verify(operation: GrantOperation, request: Request): Promise<GrantResult>;
}
export interface EntityServices<Row extends object, Edit extends object> {
	crud: AsamCrudServices<Row, Query, Edit, Id>;
}
export interface AdministrationServices {
	version: string;
	users: EntityServices<UserRow, UserEdit>;
	roles: EntityServices<RoleRow, RoleEdit>;
	menus: EntityServices<MenuRow, MenuEdit>;
	roleOptions(request: Request): Promise<readonly RoleOption[]>;
	menuNodes(request: Request): Promise<readonly GrantNode[]>;
	grants: GrantService;
}
export interface AdministrationHost {
	security: Pick<SecurityController, 'state' | 'check' | 'permission' | 'onInvalidate'>;
	runtime: AsamDataRuntime;
	writes: AsamWriteCoordinator;
	operations: AsamTableOperationCoordinator;
	/** Host owned, retained across page removal and security invalidation. */
	receipts: Map<string, GrantReceipt>;
	services: Ref<AdministrationServices>;
	size: Ref<AsamControlSize>;
	confirm(message: string): Promise<boolean>;
	unknownRoles: 'preserve' | 'reject';
	leaves?: Set<() => Promise<boolean>>;
}
export const administrationKey: InjectionKey<AdministrationHost> = Symbol('asam-administration');
